m920055.まあ、いいさ。\nもっと強い魔物でも探しにいくとするか。: Well, that's fine. I suppose I'll go look for even stronger monsters.

I… I can't… I… it's over…
Even breathing is painful…
m920055.もう大丈夫ですよ。\nお怪我はありませんか？:
It's all right now.
Are you hurt?
m920055.もう私たちの力は必要なさそうですね！: Looks like we aren't needed anymore!
m920055.やってみる前にあきらめるのは感心しないね。\nふつうのやり方でダメなら……そう、: I don't admire giving up before trying. If the usual way doesn't work… then, say, devouring the spirits might do the trick.
m920055.やはり、あのデーモンは力を吸収しすぎたようです。\n強大な力を維持するためにはそ:
As expected, that demon has absorbed too much power.
To maintain such overwhelming strength, it needs a matching amount of energy.

m920055.よろしければ詳しい話を\nお聞かせいただけませんか？\nなにかお力になれるかもし:
If you'd like, could you tell us the details?
We might be able to help.
m920055.わしに仲間を結集する力をくれ！\n妖怪軍団を結成し、\n再び人間どもを恐怖に陥れ: Give me the power to gather allies! I'll form a legion of youkai and plunge humanity back into terror!
m920055.われが魔物を使い、人間のいない世界を\n作ってみせよう。\nさすれば、そなたもわ: I shall command monsters and create a world without humans. Then you, too, will finally understand my words.
m920055.ウン。\nイママデ沢山タスケテクレテ、アリガトウ！\nコレカラハ、オレタチダケデ:
Yeah.
Thanks for all the help you've given us so far!
From now on, we'll handle it ourselves.
m920055.エルフ族の争いになど興味はない。\nフフ、まあそうだな。人間を倒そうというならば: I have no interest in the elves' petty squabbles. Heh, well… if you're set on defeating humans, I might just grant you some power.
m920055.グレーターデーモンとは誰のことかな？\n……ワシはもはやグレーターデーモンではな: Who do you think the Greater Demon is? …I am no longer the Greater Demon.
m920055.グレーターデーモンを超えた究極の存在！！\nゴールデンデーモン様だ！！: The ultimate being that surpasses the Greater Demon!! I am the Golden Demon!
m920055.コ、ココハ女神神殿の森！\nタ、タイキャク……。:
Th-this is the goddess's temple forest!
I… I'm terrified…
m920055.ゴールデンデーモンが動き始めました。\nしかし、移動速度が極めて……極めて足が遅:
The Golden Demon has started moving.
But its speed is… unbelievably slow!
m920055.チカラガ、ミナギッテクル……！\nオレタチモ、タタカウ！\nイマナラオークモコワ:
Our power is growing…!
We'll fight too!
We're not scared of the Orc any more!
m920055.チッ。お前らの様な弱そうなやつらに興味はない。\n俺はもっと強いやつと……。:
Tch. I'm not interested in weaklings like you.
I want someone stronger…
m920055.ハハハ！\nこれはちょうどよいところに魔物の群れが。\nさあ、貴様たち！ 一糸乱: Ha ha ha! A perfect swarm of monsters appears right on cue. Now, you! Show me a flawless formation!
m920055.ヒョォォォ！\n見よ！ この鋭きカギ爪を！\n王子！ 今こそお前の首をもらいうけ:
Hyooo!
Behold these keen claws!
Prince! Now I shall take your head!
m920055.フェスさん……。あなたのご友人なんですもの。\n私たちは常闇の聖霊さんがきっとい: Fes… You're a friend of hers. We believe the Holy Spirit will someday return to her true self.
m920055.フェスさん、一緒に後を追いましょう！: Fes, let's chase after her together!
m920055.フェスさん、気を落とさないでください。\n今は一刻も早く常闇の聖霊を見つけましょ: Fes, don't lose heart. We must find the Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness as quickly as possible.
m920055.フェスよ、その必要はない。\nすべては、われ自身が招いたこと。\n封印されるのは:
Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness: Fes, that's unnecessary.
Everything here is my own doing.
If I must be sealed, let it be just me.
m920055.フェス！ \n……そなた、なぜ人間などという\n下等なやつらと共におるのだ！: Fes! …You, why are you consorting with those lowly humans?
m920055.フハハッ。人間同士の戦いは、なかなかに\n面白いものだな。よかろう。\n鬼刃衆と:
Fuhaha. Watching humans fight each other is rather entertaining.
Very well.
Oni Blade Squad, I shall grant you power.
m920055.フフ、ちょうどいい。\nあそこにいる魔物の動きを強化してやろう。: Heh, just the right time. I'll boost the creature over there.
m920055.フン。良いだろう。\n人間ども、悪いがそういうことだ。\n死んでもらおう！: Hmph. Fine then. Humans are a nuisance, after all. Let them die!
m920055.ワシは決めた。\n君を手元にずっと置いておく事にしたよ。\n君は永遠にワシに力を: I've decided. I'll keep you right by my side forever. You'll keep pouring your power into me eternally!!
m920055.世迷い事を言うな！\n人間は聖霊を幸せになどしない！\n私は、私は……。:
Don't spout nonsense!
Humans will never make a holy spirit happy!
I… I…
m920055.人間と聖霊が力を合わせた時、\nどんな困難ものり越えることができる。\nそれを証: When humans and spirits combine their power, they can overcome any hardship. Prove it!
m920055.人間は自分の事しか考えていない\n自分勝手な生き物だ。われらの事なぞ、\n使い捨: Humans only think of themselves—self-centered creatures. They must see us as nothing more than disposable tools.
m920055.何だったのだ今のは……。\nあの動きに何の意味が。\n最後に出てきた騎馬は一体！: What was that just now…? What does that movement mean? And that cavalry that showed up at the end—what on earth!
m920055.先ほどの戦いは見事だった。\n私は光彩の聖霊フェス。改めてお礼を言う。\n助けて:
The battle earlier was splendid.
I am the holy spirit of light, Fes. I want to thank you again.
Thank you for saving me.
m920055.先ほどの魔物だが、おそらく私の友人である\n闇の聖霊のせいだ……。彼女がやつらに: The monsters we just faced were probably because of my friend, the dark holy spirit… She must have given them new power.
m920055.力が……溢れてくる……！\n聖霊のみなさん！\nありがとうございます！: The power… is overflowing! Holy Spirits, thank you!
m920055.力を与えるだと？ 欲しければ自らで奪い取る！\n貴様などに恵んでもらうつもりはな:
Grant power, you say? If I want it, I'll take it myself!
I won't beg you for a gift.
Even without that, I'm strong…
m920055.君はワシの話を聞いていたのかね。\nこの常闇の聖霊はすでにワシのものなのだ。\n: Were you listening to me? This Holy Spirit is already mine. There's no way I'd let it go.
m920055.報告！ 魔物たちが隊列を組んで\nこちらに向かってきています！: Report! The monsters are forming ranks and marching toward us!
m920055.大丈夫、私たちの祝福を貴方達に授けましょう。: Don't worry, we'll grant you our blessings.
m920055.女神アイギス様に、\n力を貸してもらいたいことがあってな。:
???: We need the goddess Aegis' help.
We want to ask for her power.
m920055.妖怪総大将……なかなかのものであったが\n完全に力を取り戻すには\n時間が足りな: The Grand General of the Youkai… impressive, but you didn't have enough time to fully regain your power.
m920055.少し寝ている間に……、\n人間も随分と強くなったものだ。: While I was dozing off… humans have become surprisingly strong.
m920055.常闇の聖霊……。\nやはり、その力を悪い魔物たちに与えていたか。: The Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness… So, it really has been handing its power to those vile monsters.
m920055.常闇の聖霊……。魔物にこんな邪悪な力を\n与えるなんて……。本来ならば友人の私が: Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness… to give such wicked power to monsters… I, as a friend, should be the one to stop her.
m920055.常闇の聖霊……！ ヒョッヒョッ！\n丁度いいところに来てくれた。: Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness…! Heh heh! You came at just the right time.
m920055.常闇の聖霊さん……。\nこれからは、力を悪い事に使わないと……。\n魔物に手を貸:
Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness: From now on, you won't use that power for evil…
Will you promise not to aid the monsters?
m920055.常闇の聖霊さん！ ご無事ですか！？: Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness: You're safe! Are you alright?!
m920055.幸せがある限り、僕は力を取り戻せる。\n何度でもね。:
As long as there's happiness, I can regain my power.
Again and again.
m920055.役目だと？ 愚かなる人間にわれらの力を\n奪われることの何が役目だ。そなたこそ、: A “duty,” you say? What use is it for foolish humans to steal our power? Wake up, you—how long will you keep clinging to your human fantasies?
m920055.彼女がそこまで追い詰められていることに\n私や他の聖霊の仲間たちが気づいた時には: When we and the other holy spirits finally realized how far she had been driven, it was already too late…
m920055.彼女の絶望と呼応するように、\n闇の聖霊は魔物の秘められた力を引きだす能力を\n: In response to her despair, the dark holy spirit acquired the ability to draw out the hidden power of monsters.
m920055.彼女を探し出さなければ人間界が危ない。\nどうか手伝ってはもらえないだろうか……: If we don't find her, the human world is in danger. Could you help me…!
m920055.待ちたまえ！\n他の魔物が強くなってしまったら\nワシが最強ではなくなるかもしれ: Wait a minute! If the other monsters get stronger, I might not be the strongest any more.
m920055.心配いらないよ。\n人間の力だけで、どうしようもなかったらね。\nそんな時は、聖: Don't worry. If human power alone isn't enough, just borrow the spirit's strength.
m920055.必要なものは個々の力よりも\n集団として戦える連携かもしれんな。\nそうだ、次は: What they truly need may be teamwork, not just individual strength. Right, I'll grant them wisdom next.
m920055.恐怖、か……。悪くない。よかろう。\nお前の下に妖怪が集まるようにしてやる。: Terror, huh… Not bad. Very well. I'll make the youkai flock beneath you.
m920055.愚かな……。逃げられないのは貴様たちの方だ。\nここがどこなのか、そのくすんだ目:
Foolish… You're the ones who can't run away.
Take a good look at where you are with those dull eyes.
m920055.我らは、そこにいる王子を滅ぼす為に\n力を欲している！\nそして、我らは、既に魔:
We seek power to destroy the Prince there!
And we already bear demonic power within our bodies.
m920055.永久に揺蕩う深淵の闇の力よ、わが下に集え！\nわがしもべに敵を引き裂く鋭利なる刃:
Eternal, swirling abyssal darkness, gather beneath me!
I shall give my servants a razor-sharp blade to rend their foes…!
m920055.永久に揺蕩う深淵の闇の力よ、わが下に集え！\nわがしもべに敵を粉砕せし剛腕の力を:
Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness: Eternal abyssal darkness, gather beneath me!
I will bestow upon my servants the crushing might of steel arms to shatter foes…!
m920055.永久に揺蕩う深淵の闇の力よ、わが下に集え！\nわがしもべに敵を翻弄せし俊足の力を: Darkness of the abyss that drifts forever, gather beneath me! Grant my servants the swift, bewildering speed to confound their enemies…!
m920055.永久に揺蕩う深淵の闇の力よ、わが下に集え！\nわがしもべに敵を貫き、\n焼き尽く: Darkness of the abyss that drifts forever, gather beneath me! Grant my servants the power to pierce their foes and scorch them with utter black flame…!
m920055.永久に揺蕩う深淵の闇の力よ、わが下に集え！\nわがしもべに絶大なる求心の力を与え: Abyssal darkness that forever drifts, gather beneath me! I'll grant my servants overwhelming, centripetal power!
m920055.永久に揺蕩う深淵の闇の力よ、わが下に集え！\nわがしもべに肩を並べ戦列を作る知恵: Eternal darkness of the swirling abyss, gather beneath me! I'll grant my servants the wisdom to form battle lines shoulder to shoulder…!
m920055.永久に揺蕩う深淵の闇の力よ、わが下に集え！\nわれは邪悪なる力を抱えし許されざる: Abyssal darkness that forever drifts, gather beneath me! I am an unholy being bearing wicked power. I'll bestow upon my servants a great blessing of darkness…!!
Eternal darkness of the swirling abyss, gather beneath me! I am the forbidden one bearing evil power. To my servants I bestow the curse of ruin and the blessing of darkness…!
m920055.海まで来てみたが、なかなか\n人間を根絶やしに出来るほどの\n強い力を持った魔物: I've come all the way to the sea, and yet there are no monsters strong enough to wipe out humanity.
m920055.無事に倒せてよかったです。\nでは王子、戻りましょう。: I'm glad we managed to defeat them safely. Now, Prince, let's return.
m920055.王子、\n油断されませぬよう、戦闘の準備を！: Prince, stay on guard and prepare for battle!

Prince, over there… no, a holy spirit, I think.

m920055.王子、あの動きには何か意味が\nあるのかもしれませんよ。: Prince, there may be meaning behind that movement.

m920055.王子、彼女を助けないと！\nでも一体、どうすれば……。: Prince, we have to save her! But how…?
m920055.王子、鎧を叩き潰すのは得意分野だ。\nあいつの相手はあっしらに任せてくだせぇ。:
Prince, smashing armor is my specialty.
Leave that foe to us.
m920055.王子よ、常闇の聖霊を赦してくれて、ありがとう。: Prince, thank you for forgiving the Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness.

m920055.王子！ 常闇の聖霊を見つけました！\nそれに側にいるのは……、オーク！？:
Prince! I found the Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness!
And beside it… an Orc!?
m920055.知っての通り、自分たち聖霊には元々人間に力を貸すという\n役目がある。: As you know, we holy spirits are originally tasked with lending power to humans.
m920055.知るか！ このうつけどもが。\n鬼刃衆とやらも所詮は人間か。\nやはり力を与えた:
I don't care! You fools.
Even the Oni Blade Squad are just humans anyway.
Giving them power was pointless.
m920055.私が目を覚ました時には傍にいたはずの闇の聖霊は\nすでにいなかった。: When I awoke, the dark holy spirit who should have been by my side was already gone.
m920055.聖霊の力を奪い尽くす忌々しいやつらよ。\n人間など……、皆いなくなればよいのだ…: You cursed beings who would drain the spirit's power! Humans… they should all just disappear…!
m920055.自分たちがどんなに人間たちに尽くしても\n徒に仲間たちの力が奪われるばかりの現実: No matter how much we serve humanity, we only see our comrades' power being taken away in vain, and we finally fell into despair.
m920055.良かった。どうかお元気で。: Glad to hear it. Take care.
m920055.貴様だけでは心もとないな。\nどれ、他の魔物にも力を与えてやるか……。: You alone aren't enough. How about I grant power to the other monsters as well…?
m920055.逃げたりしません。\n私たちも聖霊たちの力を借りているのです。:
We won't run away.
We're also drawing on the Holy Spirits' power.
m920055.邪魔者たちは手下のデーモンどもに任せるとしよう。\nさあ、お前はこっちに来い！\: I'll leave the meddlesome ones to my minion demons. Now, come over here! Give me more power, make me even more golden!
m920055.面白い、ならば力を授けてやってもよい。\nだが、まずは、そこの人間どもを本当に\:
Interesting. Then I may grant you power.
But first, show me you truly intend to annihilate those humans.
m920055.頼む常闇の聖霊よ！ 我々ダークエルフに\nエルフ族を倒すための力を与えてくれ！: Hear me, Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness! Grant us Dark Elves the power to defeat the Elf race!
m920055.馬鹿な……！\n私は人間たちを憎んでいるのだ！\n人間との約束など守りはせぬぞ！:
Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness: Ridiculous…!
I despise humans!
I won't keep any promise to them!
m920055.（……今だ！）\n常闇の聖霊よ！ 我らに力をくれ！:
(…Now!)
Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness! Grant us power!
m920055.？？\n（今人の声が聞こえたような……。気のせいか。）:
??
(I thought I heard a human voice just now… Was it my imagination?)

m920062.――ぐァッ……スクハ、なぜわしを拒む？\n莫邪よ、なぜじゃ！？ 宝剣は未だわしの: —Gua… Sukuha, why do you reject me? Mo Ye, why!? The treasure sword is still in my hand—what's… what is this!?
m920062.――っは、ぁッ、め、面目ありません。ですが\nもう大丈夫です。私はもう独りではな: …Ha, ah, I have no excuse. But it's alright now. I'm no longer alone. My friends are supporting this Sukuha!
m920062.――ッあ、く……か、干将は……ドコ……？\n干将に……アイタイ……。ワタシの夫…: —…where… is Ganjiang…? I want to see Ganjiang… my husband…
m920062.……あ、あの、本当に身体から雷が\n出ていますぞ？ バチバチって。: …Um, is it really lightning shooting out of my body? It's crackling.
m920062.……うおおおおおッ！！！\nち、力がみなぎってくるぞぉおっ！！！: …Uuuuu!!! The power's surging!! It's flooding through me!!!
m920062.……え？ 莫邪の剣が……鳴動している……？\nまさか――ッ！？: …huh? The Mo Ye sword… is resonating…? No way—!?
m920062.……くっ。貴様らの力をあまく見ておったわい。\nまぁよいわ。\nスクハの国は既に: …Damn. I underestimated your strength. Fine. Sukuha's nation is already mine.
m920062.……ぐ。こうなったら、力尽くよ。\n砂漠の戦士は臆さない！\n最後に頼れるのは鍛: …Ugh. If that's the case, I'll go all-out. A desert warrior never backs down! In the end, all I can rely on is my own hardened body!
m920062.……す、すごい。\nここまでの武人が、\n一国の王として現存するなんて……。: …i-incredible. To think a warrior like you still exists as a kingdom's king…
m920062.……はい……このスクハが、身命を賭して、\n貴方達を御守りします……もう二度と、: …Yes… I, Sukuha, will stake my life to protect you… so that the two of you will never be separated again… I promise…
m920062.あっ……！ くっそぉ、逃げ足だけは速いんだから！\n……ごめん、スクハちゃん、剣: Ah…! Damn, you're fast on your feet! …I'm sorry, Sukuha-chan, we couldn't retrieve the sword…
m920062.あれは、妖虎仙の配下にある妖虎……。\nやはり、追っ手を差し向けていたのですね。: That's a Yōko-sen's subordinate—another Yōko. So they did send a pursuer after us. To be found so quickly…
m920062.あんなところに虎が……！？\nきっと何処からか迷い込んだんだわ。\nあんなに沢山: A tiger over there...!? It must've wandered in from somewhere. So many of them—what do we do...?
m920062.いえ、これで良かったのです。\n宝剣に宿りし二つの魂は、こうして一つに\nなるこ: No, this is exactly how it should be. The two souls dwelling in the sacred sword have finally become one.
m920062.うぅ……はやく、ここから……。\n逃げなく、ては……。: …Ugh… quickly, get out of here… Can't… run…
m920062.うーん、狩った狩ったぁ♪\nさーて、こいつらどうしようかなー。:
Hmm, hunted 'em, hunted 'em♪
Now, what should we do with these guys?
m920062.え……そ、そうですか。\nそれは……いいかも、しれないですね。\nあはは……。:
Huh… i-indeed.
That might… actually be nice.
Haha…
m920062.え、ちょっと、ルナールさんッ！？\n待って下さい、私も一緒に行きます。\nお願い:
Eh, wait, Lunarl-san!?
Please, let me come along too.
I'm begging you, let me go!!
m920062.おい、見ろよ！\nあそこに誰か倒れてるぞ！？\n……ん、おいおい、女じゃねえか！: Hey, look! Someone's fallen over there! …huh, hey hey, it's a woman!?
m920062.おおっ！？\nなんだか面白そうなことしてるなっ？\n魔物倒すのか？ いいぞっ、力: Whoa!? That looks fun! Taking down monsters? Count me in, I'll lend my strength!
m920062.お前が国を取り戻したければ、\n何れまた見えよう。\nでは、さらばだ。: If you wish to reclaim your country, you'll see me again someday. Until then, farewell.
m920062.かような我が身をお助け頂いたこと、\nこの命ある限り、決して忘れはしません。\n: I will never forget how you saved someone like me. Before my longing overwhelms me, I'll take my leave.
m920062.かわい、そう？ 私は、民を想って、\n臣の想いを継いで、ここまできたのに……。\: Cute, is that so? I've come this far thinking of my people, carrying on my retainers' wishes… Are you saying I'm wrong?
m920062.きゃっ……もう何なのよ、この砂ぼこりは。\nふつうに進軍するだけで疲れちゃうわ。: …Eek… what's with all this sand dust? Just marching normally wears me out. The sun's blazing too. *huff* I feel like I'm gonna collapse…
m920062.ぐわあああっ！！\nなんだこれは！？\n痺れて回避が出来ぬ……！: Gwaaah!! What is this!? I'm numb—I can't even dodge!!
m920062.ここにこうしてエサをまいてっと……。\nうん！ これで準備はオーケーだよ！\nう: I'll just scatter bait here... Yeah! All set. We'll buy time and take down the tigers one by one.
m920062.ここら一帯の虎を全て討伐できたようですね。\nご助力、本当にありがとうございまし:
Looks like we've cleared all the tigers in this area.
Thank you so much for your help!
m920062.この奇跡は、新たな伝承となり語り継がれて\nいくことでしょう……こんなに嬉しいこ: This miracle will become a new legend passed down through the ages… I've never been this happy… *sniff*… *sob*…
m920062.これからの戦いはより苛烈さを増すでしょう。\n皆さんに傷ついてほしくないというの: The battles ahead will only get harsher. I honestly don't want anyone to get hurt, but I also need your help...
m920062.これを煎じて飲めば、\n魔神フールフールの力が手に入るのだ！: If we brew it and drink it, we'll obtain FoorFoor's power!
m920062.さ、山岳地帯……。\nまだまだ先は長そうね……。: Alright, the mountain region... Looks like we still have a long way to go...
m920062.しかし……私は姫……一国を担う者が、\n他国の者にすがるなど、我が民をおとしめる: But… I'm a princess… A ruler of a nation can't cling to a foreigner—it would disgrace my people… I can't…
m920062.しかし、大帝の望む宝剣を造るのは\nとても難しく、その宝剣の完成と引き換えに、\: But forging the emperor's desired sword was so hard that the couple perished when it was completed…
m920062.しっかりしてください！\n一体なにがあったと言うのですか？: Hold it together! What on earth happened?
m920062.じゃがわしがすぐに思い出させてやるわぃ。\n宝剣の担い手として、永劫の番いとなり: But I'll make you remember right away. As the bearer of the treasure sword, I'll become your eternal guardian, cherishing and pitying you until death.
m920062.すごい力だ……。\nビリビリしてきたぞ……！！\nまるで雷の茨が身体中を覆うよう: Such amazing power… It's tingling… It feels like lightning vines wrapping my whole body!!
m920062.そ、そのようなことは……\nすみません、実は少しだけ、\n本当に少しだけ怖いので: Well, that's not... I'm sorry, but actually I'm a little—just a little—scared.
m920062.そ、そんな馬鹿な……！ う、うろたえるな！\nたかがアリだ！ 崖に引っ付いてる間: No way… This can't be…! Don't lose your composure! It's just an ant! While it's clinging to the cliff, fire off long-range arrows! Please, Ars!
m920062.そうか、ならバシラの分も作ってやるぞ！\nお揃いはいいぞ。仲間だ！ そしたら、\:
Great, then I'll make one for you too, Bashira!
Matching outfits are awesome. We're comrades! Then we can hunt even more!
m920062.そうだなー。\nルナールみたいな、かっこいい感じの\nかぶり物にするのもいいな！:
Well…
A cool, stylish headpiece like Lunarl's would be nice!
m920062.そりゃそうだ。俺の経験則からいくと、\nこんな絶壁をよじ登ってくる魔物は存在しな:
That's right. From my experience, no monster can climb a sheer cliff like this.
Well, an easy advance—can't complain. Hahaha!
m920062.それに、こちらには『干将剣』があるのだ。\n逃げることなどできんぞ、皇女スクハ…: Besides, we have the Ganjiang Sword. There's no way you can escape, Princess Sukuha…
m920062.それにしても、おかしいですね……。\n私がここを通った時は、あの様な魔物は\nい: Still, it's odd… When I passed through here earlier, there were no such monsters…
m920062.そんなに慌ててどうしたの、バシラ？\n……あーなるほど、迷い虎かぁ。\n大丈夫、: Why the rush, Bashira? ...Ah, I see, lost tigers. Don't worry, leave the tiger hunting to me!
m920062.たすけて……ください……。\nもう……ひとりでは……逃げられない……。\n私……: Help… please… I can't… run away alone anymore… I… I… ugh…
m920062.だ、大丈夫ですか……？\n（前にも確かこんなことが……）: A-are you alright…? (I think I've seen something like this before…)
m920062.ちょ、ちょっとエレインさん！\nここは高地ですよ？\nあ、危ないですって……ひゃ: Hey, wait a sec, Elaine! This is high ground, you know? Ah, it's dangerous... Whoa!
m920062.ついに、ついに、ついに！\n……手に入れたぞ！: At last, at last, at last! …We've got it!
m920062.ついに山頂まできました。\n見晴らしの良い開けた場所です。\nお気を付けください:
We've finally reached the summit.
It's an open spot with a great view.
Please be careful.
m920062.ですがここを通らなくては、妖虎仙の許に辿り\n着けません……。本当に申し訳ありま: But we have to get through here to reach the spirit-tiger sage… I'm truly sorry for dragging you into this.
m920062.ですが危険な山道であるが故に、敵の襲撃は\n前方のみに絞られますので、迎撃は容易: Though the trail is dangerous, the enemy can only strike from ahead, so intercepting them will be easy.
m920062.ですが敵の動きが不自然です……。\n私達を警戒して距離をとっているのか、\nある: But the enemy's movements are odd… Are they keeping their distance out of caution, or… Either way, stay alert.
m920062.どうか、王子のその武勇を、\n私達の国の為に、お貸し頂きたい。: Please, lend your bravery, Prince, for the sake of our nation.
m920062.どうしようって、\nどうするつもりなのですか……？:
What do you mean, “what should we do”…
What are you planning to do?
m920062.どうってことないよ、こんなの。\nそれに、ベラなんかは自分から協力して、\nむし:
No big deal, it's nothing.
Besides, Vera even volunteered on her own—she's practically here to play.
m920062.どうでしょう、スクハさん？\n魔物が復活した今、残った者達は皆で\n手を取り合う: What do you think, Sukuha-san? Now that the monsters have revived, shouldn't the survivors all join hands?
m920062.どうやらここは魔界アリの巣と\n化しているようですね。: It seems this place has become a nest for those demonic ants.
m920062.なッ、何言っちゃってるのよスクハちゃん！\nあんまり私を見くびらないで。まだやれ: Hey, what are you saying, Sukuha-chan! Don't underestimate me. I can still handle this! Haa! Elaine the lancer, charging forward!
m920062.はぁ……はぁ、ど、どうよスクハちゃん？\nわ、私だってこれくらい、やれるんだから:
Haa… haa, wh-what do you think, Sukuha-chan?
I can handle this much too.
Don't underestimate me…!
m920062.はぁ。肝心な時に、目が回っちゃうなんて……。\n今度こそ……！ そりゃっ――\n: Haa. To get dizzy right when it matters… This time…! Of course— Ah, I'm dizzy again! Someone, please stop me!
m920062.はい。ですので、我が祖国へと向かうことで、\n妖虎仙と出会うのは必定。\nこのま: Yes. Therefore, heading toward my homeland means meeting Yōko-sen is inevitable. Continuing on is the fastest route.
m920062.はいっ。\nもうすぐ山岳地帯が見えてくるはずです。: Alright! We'll be seeing the mountains soon.
m920062.はひぃー。もうヘトヘトだよ……。\n喉もからからだし！\n砂漠なんて大っ嫌い。: Haa— I'm exhausted… My throat's dry! I hate the desert.
m920062.ひっ……！ み、皆さん、あれを！\n崖にびっしりと魔界アリが……！: H-huh…! Everyone, look! The cliff is swarming with demonic ants!
m920062.ふぅ。\nようやく中腹くらいかしら。\nもうちょっとだね。頑張ろう！: Phew. I think we're finally halfway up. Just a bit more. Let's push on!
m920062.ふぉっふぉっふぉ、見つけたぞ皇女スクハ。\n干将もさぞや嬉しかろう。見えるか？:
Fo-fo-fo, I've found you, Princess Sukuha.
Ganjiang must be thrilled. Can you see? You and my wife. Ah… it's almost time…
m920062.ふぉっふぉっふぉ。\nそう泣くでない。これよりわしらは永久に結ばれ\n決して離れ: Fo-fo-fo. Don't cry like that. From now on we're bound forever and will never part.
m920062.ふぉっふぉっふぉ。干将が荒々しく泣きよるわ。\n宝剣同士はひかれ合う……逸話に違:
Fo-fo-fo. Ganjiang cries out wildly.
The treasure swords attract each other… just as the legend says,
truly a strange mystery.
m920062.ふふーん、どうよスクハちゃん？\n王子ってとっても頼りになるでしょ？: Hehe, what do you think, Sukuha-chan? The Prince is super reliable, right?
m920062.ほっほ。待たれよ砂漠の猛者よ。\nアリの硬い外殻を打ち破るには魔法が有効じゃて。: Ho ho. Hold your horses, desert tough-guy. Magic's the way to shatter that ant's tough carapace.
m920062.まあいいや。これぜーんぶアタシのだ。\nにしし、王子にも毛皮で何か作って\nやろ:
Whatever, it's all mine now.
Heh, I'll even craft something from fur—maybe for the Prince too.
What a great day…♪
m920062.まさか魔界アリが現れるとはのぅ。\n千年戦争の時に封じられ滅びたと思っておったが: Who would've thought demonic ants would appear? I thought they were sealed away and perished during the Millennium War, but we've run into some troublesome ones.
m920062.まるで磁石よね。\nどうしてそんな不思議な力が宿っているの？: It's like a magnet. How does it hold such a strange power?
m920062.む、無念……。\nつ、次こそは必ず……！: Hmph, frustrating… Next time, for sure…!
m920062.もう、泣かないの！ スクハちゃん！\n……でも……ぐすっ……よかった……、\n本: Stop crying, Sukuha-chan! …But… *sniff*… I'm so glad… really glad!
m920062.もうすぐ、この砂漠地帯を抜ける事が出来ます。\nそれまで、もう少々のご辛抱をお願: We'll be out of this desert soon. Please bear with us a little longer.
m920062.もうやってるって！\nでも外殻が硬すぎて、矢が刺さらねえ！: I'm already on it! But its shell's too hard—our arrows won't pierce it!
m920062.やつの手にする剣が、\n急に光り始めたぞ……どういうことだ？: The sword in his hand suddenly started glowing… what's going on?
m920062.ようやくお目にかかれましたな、皇女スクハ。\nそして、愛しの我が対極――莫邪どの:
At last we meet, Princess Sukuha.
And my beloved opposite—Lord Mo Ye.
m920062.よかったね、バシラ。\n出来たらちゃんとあたしにも\n見せてよね？ それじゃあね:
Nice work, Bashira.
When you've made it, show it to me, okay? See you later.
m920062.んー？\nなんだ、バシラのやつ、\n自分の取り分も置いて行っちゃったぞ？:
Hmm?
What's up, Bashira…
You left your share behind?
m920062.ん？\nもしかしてお嬢ちゃん、\n高いところが苦手なのか？: Hmm? Could it be, miss, that you're not fond of heights?
m920062.アタシも手伝いますよ！ この踊りで魔物\nだって見惚れさせてみせま――わわッ！: I'll help too! With this dance, I'll even make the monster stare in awe—Whoa! My head's spinning… Who…? Someone… stop me!
m920062.ウソでしょう……？\nいったいどれだけの数を相手にしなきゃ\nいけないって言うの: You're kidding…? How many of them are we supposed to face?
m920062.エレインさん……。\n（とても疲れているはずなのに、\n本当になんとお礼を言って:
Elaine...
（Even though she's supposed to be exhausted, I really don't know how to thank her…。）
m920062.エレインさんの勇姿、しかとこのスクハの目に\n焼き付けました。その武勇と知略ゆえ:
I've firmly etched your brave figure, Elaine, into my eyes.
Because of your valor and wit, you truly are worthy companions of that brave Prince.
m920062.グルルル……。\n見つけたぞ、皇女スクハ……。\n貴様は我らから逃れることなど出: Grrr… I've found you, Princess Sukuha… You'll never escape us.
m920062.スクハさんが宝剣を所持している限り、\n剣同士の因果によって互いを引き合い、\n: As long as you hold the treasure sword, the fate of the swords will draw us together, so we'll inevitably meet, right?
m920062.スクハさん？ だ、大丈夫ですか？\n干将……？ まさか宝剣に宿る魂が、\nスクハ:
Sukuha? Are you okay?
Ganjiang…? Could the soul residing in the treasure sword be affecting you…?
m920062.スクハちゃん！ 宝剣の意思にのまれちゃ\nだめだよ……あなたは一国の王女なんでし: Sukuha-chan! You mustn't let the treasure sword's will consume you… you're a princess of a kingdom! Pull yourself together!
m920062.スクハを匿ったやつらが何者かは知らんが、\nそう遠くへは行けまい。: I don't know who hid Sukuha, but they won't get far.
m920062.タイミング悪ぅ……。\nまあいいわ、憂さ晴らしに一暴れしてやるわよ！: Bad timing… Fine, I'll let off some steam and go on a rampage!
m920062.バカなこと言ってんじゃないわよ！\nひとりで全部背負い込んで何を考えてるの？\n: Don't be ridiculous! What are you thinking, taking all this on by yourself? Your people and retainers will suffer.
m920062.一つの宝剣に、二つの魂を宿すことで、新たな\n伝説を紡いでいく……スクハさんの想: By housing two souls in a single sacred sword, we'll weave a new legend… I'm delighted we could honor Sukuha's wish. Prince, thank you for all your hard work.
m920062.中には邪悪な念に囚われ悪の手先になり果てる\n「邪仙」と呼ばれる者達がいるのです: But some become trapped by wicked thoughts and turn into minions of evil, called “evil immortals.” Yōko-sen is one of them.
m920062.二対の宝剣は、その刃を揃えることで大いなる\n力を発揮すると言い伝えられ、妖虎仙: Legend says that when the pair of swords align, they unleash great power, so it was clear Yōko-sen was after that mystery.
m920062.今まで自分を追いつめていたのでしょうね。\nスクハさんの為にも、しばし休憩をとり: You've been cornering yourself all this time, haven't you? For Sukuha's sake, let's take a short break and devise a strategy against Yōko-sen.
m920062.仙人は長年の修行によって、\n人智を超えた術を会得し、その力によって\n時には人: Immortals, through years of training, have mastered techniques beyond human understanding, and sometimes they use that power to help people…
m920062.伝令！\n斥候部隊が敵影を確認。\n恐らく妖虎仙の追っ手かと思われます。: Messenger! Scout units have spotted enemy movement. Likely a pursuer of Yōko-sen.
m920062.何とか敵を退けたようですね。\nさあ、一刻も早く、彼女をこちらに運びましょう。: It seems we managed to push the enemy back. Let's get her over here as quickly as possible.
m920062.依然として、険しい山道が続いていますね。\n一歩踏み外せば谷底へと落ちるのは必至:
The mountain path remains treacherously steep.
One misstep and we'll tumble straight down the gorge…
Everyone, stay alert as we move forward.
m920062.先ほどから、微弱ながらも莫邪の剣から\n何か不思議な力を感じています。\nもしか: Since a while ago I've been feeling a faint, mysterious power emanating from Moja's sword. Could it be the spirit-tiger sage…?
m920062.前方に敵の姿を確認！\nどうやらまた、妖虎のようです！: Enemy spotted ahead! Looks like another tiger spirit…
m920062.前方に敵影を確認！\nどうやら、こちらに向かってきているようです！: Enemy spotted ahead! Looks like they're heading straight for us!
m920062.協力させてくださいスクハさん！ このまま\n一人で逃げても、いずれ宝剣の因果が妖: Let us help you, Sukuha! If you keep running alone, the sword's destiny will inevitably draw Yōko-sen to it, and the blade will be taken.
m920062.危ないところを助けていただき、\n本当にありがとうございました。\n遅ればせなが: Thank you for rescuing me from that dangerous place. I'm truly grateful. Though it's a bit late, my name is Sukuha.
m920062.国から何とか持ち出せたのはいいのですが、\n宝剣同士は互いに共鳴し、引き合う力を: I managed to smuggle it out of the country, but the two swords are said to resonate and draw toward each other.
m920062.妖虎仙さまの為にも、必ずや貴様を……。: For the sake of Lady Yōko-sen, I'll make sure you…
m920062.妖虎仙との対決は近いですね、王子。\n干将莫邪の神秘と因果……そして妖虎仙。\n:
The showdown with the spirit-tiger sage is near, Prince.
The mystery and destiny of Ganjiang Mo Ye… and the spirit-tiger sage.
To settle everything, we must press on now.
m920062.妖虎仙の狙いは、我が国に封じられし\n二振りの宝剣『干将剣』と『莫邪剣』です。: Yōko-sen's goal is the two sealed treasure swords of my country, the Ganjiang Sword and the Mo Ye Sword.
m920062.妖虎仙は確実に私達に\n近づいているようですね。\n王子、お気を付けください！: Yōko-sen is definitely closing in on us. Prince, stay alert!
m920062.妖虎仙！？ 貴様に仇なす為、私は、わたしは、\nワタシは……か、干将……アナタ…:
Spirit-tiger sage!? To avenge you, I… I… I… Ganjiang… you… are you?
I… Mo Ye is… here.
m920062.宝剣同士が魂を導き合い、そして、スクハの\n持つ器を共存の為のよりしろと決めたの: The swords' souls are guiding each other, and they've decided that Sukuha's vessel shall become a conduit for coexistence. The holy light of guardianship fills the Mo Ye sword…
m920062.実は……祖国が妖虎仙という邪仙の襲撃にあい、\n臣下の助けのもと、何とか落ち延び: Actually… my homeland was attacked by the evil spirit Yōko-sen, and with my retainers' help I somehow escaped and ended up in that desert.
m920062.察しの通り、\nこれこそが魔神フールフールの身体の一部！\n我らに偉大なる力を授: As you guessed, this is a fragment of the demon god FoorFoor's body! It will grant us great power!
m920062.封印が解かれたのやもしれぬな。\nじゃが、一体何者が\n封印を解いたというのか…: Perhaps the seal has been broken. But who on earth could have undone it?
m920062.峻厳な山々が続きますね。\n皆さん足を踏み外さないように\nお気を付けください。: The rugged mountains stretch ahead. Please watch your step, everyone.
m920062.待ってくださいスクハさん！\nひとりで一体どこに行くというのですか！: Wait, Sukuha! Where on earth are you going alone?
m920062.後方より敵影を確認！\nこちらに向かってきています！: Enemy spotted from the rear! They're coming this way!
m920062.恐らくは間違いないかと。祖国に着くのが先か\n妖虎仙が現れるのが先か――えッ？: That's probably correct. Whether we reach the homeland first or the spirit-tiger sage appears first—huh? Suddenly, the Mo Ye sword starts to glow… eek—
m920062.惜しいのぅ、皇女スクハ。\n其方は、孤独と寂ばくこそが無二の\n化粧であったもの: How pitiful, Princess Sukuha. You thought loneliness and desolation were your only adornments…
m920062.慣れない山岳地帯での戦闘でしたが、\nなんとか無事に乗り切れましたね。\nお疲れ: Fighting in unfamiliar mountains was tough, but we made it through safely. Good job, Prince.
m920062.戯れるな、妖虎仙！ 私は、もう逃げません！\n宝剣が導いた新たな仲間との絆の許に: Don't toy with me, Youkosen! I won't run away any more! With the bond forged by the new comrades the sword led me to, I'll strike you down! Prepare yourself!
m920062.敵、すべて撃破しました。\nお疲れ様です、王子。: All enemies eliminated. Good work, Prince.
m920062.敵、すべて討ち払いました。\n王子、お疲れ様でした。: All the enemies have been swept away. Prince, thank you for your effort.
m920062.敵はすぐそこまで迫っているやもしれません。\n皆さん、気を引き締めていきましょう: The enemy might be right on top of us. Everyone, stay sharp.
m920062.敵影、すべて消失。\nやりましたね、魔界アリを退けたようです！\n本当にお疲れ様:
All enemy shadows have vanished.
We did it, looks like we've driven the demonic ants away!
Thank you for your hard work, Prince.
m920062.既に干将剣は奪われてしまいましたが、\n莫邪剣はこのように今なお、このスクハの\: The Ganjiang Sword has already been taken, but the Mo Ye Sword remains, still in my hands.
m920062.油断は禁物です。\nここは私達にとっては不慣れな地……、\nまだ見ぬ魔物がいるか:
We must stay vigilant.
This terrain's unfamiliar to us…
There could be monsters we haven't seen yet.
m920062.王子、スクハさんや彼女の国の為にも、\n妖虎仙を倒し、宝剣を取り戻すのです！\n: Prince, for Sukuha and her nation, we must defeat Youkosen and reclaim the treasure sword! Let's give it our all in battle!

m920209.レクテ、軍艦の密航は犯罪ですよ？\n誰に雇われたのか知りませんが、\nしっかりと:
Rekte, stowing away on a warship is a crime, you know?
I don't know who hired you, but you need to accept the consequences of your actions――
m920209.レクテさん、我々に敵意はありません。\nあなたにお話を伺いたいだけで――:
Rekte, we have no hostility toward you.
We simply wish to have a conversation with you――
m920209.レクテの場合はもっとヤバイ。\n何しろ一目みただけの飛空戦艦を再現できて、\n新:
Your case is even more dangerous, Rekte.
After all, you're an inventor who can replicate a flying battleship just by seeing it once,
and even build new types of power engines.
m920209.レクテよ、研究予算はデモシェフ商会が出そう。\nその知性、物質界連合軍で発揮して:
Rekte, the Demon Chef Trading Company will cover your research budget.
Wouldn't you like to put that brilliant mind to work for the Material World Coalition?
m920209.事情があるんですって言いましたよね！？\nアンナお姉様たちにご迷惑をおかけするわ:
I told you there was a situation!
I can't possibly be a bother to you and the others――
m920209.事情？ あっ、アンナさん！\nこの魔術師さん、さっきの戦いで\n手を貸してくれて:
A situation? Ah, Anna-san!
This mage here helped us out in that fight just now――gug-guh?!
m920209.今はどんな情報だって欲しい状況だ。\n案外、新しい視点が手に入るかもしれないぞ？:
Right now, we need any information we can get.
Maybe a fresh perspective could be useful, after all?
m920209.今は飲食業界を中心に、\n手広く新規事業を立ち上げる商売人でな。\n互いに魔王軍:
I'm now a businessman, focusing on the food and beverage industry,
but also launching a wide range of new ventures.
I'd say we're all more vibrant than we were back in the Demon Army.
m920209.元魔王軍、ですか……。\n我々王国軍は避けられてしまいそうですね……。:
A former member of the Demon King's army, you say…….
I imagine we'll be met with hostility, given our status as the Kingdom's military…….
m920209.切り替えが早いのはいいことです。\nほら、立ってください。\n本当に危害を加える:
It's good that you can take defeat well.
Come on, stand up.
I truly have no intention of harming you.
m920209.前にね、古代文明の遺跡を調査しに行った時に\n連中に目をつけられちゃったみたいで:
A while back, when I went to investigate a ruin of an ancient civilization,
it seems I caught their eye.
m920209.動力機関はあたしの専門分野だからね！\n飛空戦艦の技術じゃ白の帝国は一歩先を行っ:
Power systems are my specialty, after all!
The White Empire is always a step ahead in airship technology, so
I just had to see it with my own eyes!
m920209.同時に、王国軍本隊の隊列も\nこちらへ接近中とのことです！:
The Kingdom's main army is also
closing in on our position!
m920209.壮健そうでなによりだ。\nさっきの魔物たちは？:
I'm glad to see you're in good health.
What about those monsters from earlier?
m920209.専門家って言葉は、嘘じゃなさそうだ。\n今、この高度で得られた情報と合わせて\n:
So the title "expert" isn't a lie, after all.
I'm recalculating based on the data we've gathered at this altitude,
and I seem to be reaching the same conclusion.
m920209.帝国の飛空戦艦じゃ出力が足りなくて、\n何か他の手段がないか、探してるとこなんだ: The Empire's flying warships don't have enough output, so I'm trying to find some other means.
m920209.従姉妹なんですから、\nちゃんと頼ってくださいね？:
Since we're cousins,
please don't hesitate to ask for my help, okay?
m920209.我が同胞たちよ、我らが主は\n信徒が命を落とすことを望まれない。\n友を守り、我:
My fellow believers, our Lord

does not wish for His followers to lose their lives.

Protect your comrades and retreat to our temple.
m920209.敬虔なる信徒たちよ、邪教の徒に一切の慈悲はいらぬ。\nその肉体の一欠片まで滅する:
Faithful believers, show no mercy to the heretics.
We shall purge them of their sin and filth
by destroying every last fragment of their flesh.
m920209.数が増えるとな、\nああやって襲撃をしかけてくるんじゃ。:
But when their numbers grow,
they launch attacks like that one.
m920209.既存技術での改造では届かず、\nビフロストを用いるのも現実的ではない、と。: Modifying existing technology won't cut it, and using Bifrost is not practical, I see.
m920209.条件があるなら何でも言ってくれ！: If there are conditions, name them!
m920209.殲滅を目標とする必要はない。\n邪教徒との戦いは一度や二度で終わるものではないの:
There is no need to aim for total annihilation.
Our war with the heretics is not something that ends in a single battle.
Focus solely on steadily capturing our targets.
m920209.気にするなと言いたいのだろうが、\n商人としては貸し借りは気にするものだぞ。\n:
I know you're trying to tell me not to worry,
but as a merchant, I do keep track of debts and favors.
So this time, don't be shy—rely on the Demoshuf Trading Company, and――
m920209.無事に合流できそう……ではありますが、\nなんだか気持ち悪い魔力の波を感じますね:
It looks like we'll be able to join up safely……,

but I'm sensing some rather unsettling waves of magic…….
m920209.王国が重鎮、政務官が肉親の身柄を確保し、\n我らが真なる雷神の教えに改宗させるこ:
Secure the person of the Kingdom's senior statesman,
the official's own flesh and blood,
and force them to convert to the teachings of our true Thunder God.
m920209.王子さま、たぶん神聖騎士団は、\n亜神ディアスに手を届かせるあらゆる手段を、\n:
Prince, the Holy Knights likely intend to
erase every means of reaching the Demi-god Dias
from the material world.
m920209.王子には何かと世話になっていることだし、\nここで借りを返させてほしい。:
Besides, I've received so much help from the Prince.
Allow me to return the favor on this occasion.
m920209.異教の民よ、邪神を崇める邪教の者たちよ。\n我らは地上の神罰代行者。\n汝らに、:
O followers of false gods, you who worship the wicked deity.

We are the agents of divine judgment on this earth.

We shall grant you purification through death.
m920209.研究環境は王国が用意しましょう。\nあなたの慧眼は、放置しておくには惜しいもので:
The Kingdom will provide the research facilities.
Your keen insight is far too valuable to be left idle.
m920209.確か、動力機関の改造を\n見学したくてここに来たって言ってたよな？: If I recall correctly, she said she came here to observe the modifications to the power engine?
m920209.神聖騎士団は、\n王国としても最大級の警戒対象ですからね。:
The Holy Knights are, after all,
the highest-priority threat to the Kingdom.
m920209.私たちみたいなデーモンや、アンデッドには\n癒やしの効果がないの！\nこれだから:
Healing effects don't work on us Demons or the Undead!

This is exactly why I hate Celestial powers!
--- scene: Jimenes's Objective (battle, battle) ---
m920209.空で大爆発とか、しゃれにならんのう……。: A massive explosion in the sky would be quite the spectacle, wouldn't it……
m920209.結論から言うと、\nこの船体と、この動力じゃ今の高度が限界だよ。:
To get straight to the point,
this hull and these engines have hit their limit at this altitude.
m920209.繋いでみてもいいけど、\nたぶん技術体系が違いすぎて艦が爆発するよ？: I could hook you up, but our tech systems are so different the ship would probably explode.
m920209.超高高度飛行と、物質界と天界の壁を超える技術。\nその両方が揃わないと、\nあの:
Ultra-high-altitude flight, and the technology to breach the wall between the Material and Celestial Realms.
Unless we have both,
I don't think we can ever reach that place.
m920209.追跡ならお任せあれ！\n王子の旦那、後から付いてきてください！:
Leave the pursuit to me!
Prince, please follow behind us!
m920209.違う違う。\n帝国も怖いけど、あたしを追い回してるのは、\n神聖騎士団ってやつら:
No, no.
The Empire is scary, but the ones chasing me
are the Holy Knights.
m920209.魔物どもよ、我が剣の錆としてくれる！\n――って、多い！ 数が多い！！:
Monsters, you shall become the rust on my blade!
――Wait, there are so many! Too many of them!!
m920209.魔王軍の頃は発明なんてさせてもらえなかったし。\nようやく見つけた、好き勝手に研:
Back in the Demon King's army, I was never allowed to invent anything.
This place, where I can finally research whatever I want,
I absolutely cannot afford to lose it!
m920209.（えぇーい、今しかない！\nファイト、レクテちゃん、おーっ！！）:
(Oh, come on, now or never!
Fight, Rekte-chan, ooooh!!)
m920209.（おや？ アンジェラ……？\n確かアンナさんの母君のお名前では？）:
(Hm? Angela……?
Wasn't that Anna's mother's name?)
m920209.（お母様から聞いた話では、\n伯母様――アンジェラお姉様の母君は、\n小さい頃、:
(From what Mother told me,
Auntie――Angela's mother――
was quite the big-sister type when she was little.)
m920209.（だが、あの者だけで天に手が届くことはなかろう。\nそして今の戦力で、\n王国軍:
(But that one alone cannot reach the heavens.
And a head-on clash with the Kingdom's army
would be a bad move with our current forces.)
m920209.（ですです。\nアンナお姉様の母君と、\nアンジェラお姉様は同じ名前なんですよ）:
(It was.
Anna's mother and Angela share the same name.)
m920209.（なるほど。\nそれで尊敬する姉の名を、愛する娘に付けたと。\nああ、でもあの姿:
(I see.
So she named her beloved daughter after the sister she admired.
Ah, though seeing her like that――)
m920209.（なれば、今なすべきことは――）: (Then, what we must do now is――)
m920209.（わっ、なに？ これチャンス？\n今がチャンス逃げるチャンス！？）:
??? : (Whoa, what's that? Is this my chance?
Now is the chance! The chance to escape!?)
m920209.（王子まで合流したか……。\nこの作戦は失敗だな）:
(So the Prince has joined them as well…….

This operation is a failure.)
m920209.（鋼の都に住まう悪魔の発明家は、\n王国の手に落ちたと報告があった……）:
(The demonic inventor from the Steel City
has fallen into the Kingdom's hands, I'm told...)

m920240.――おっと、快進撃はそこまでだ。: ――Oh, that's enough of a victory lap.
m920240.――おや？\nそのモリグナンとトリステラはどちらへ？:
――Hm?
Where did Morigan and Tristella go?
m920240.――その全てを、一切の迷いなく、\n殺し、砕き、世界の平和を守り抜く強き王が。:
—a strong king who will kill and shatter all of it
without a shred of hesitation,
and defend the world's peace to the bitter end.
m920240.――それから、もうひとつ。\n姫様が絶対に必要だからと。:
—And one more thing.
Because Her Highness absolutely needs it.
m920240.――だから、てめぇの手で\nそのくだらねぇ平和な世界を作ろうっていうのか。:
—So, you intend to create that worthless, peaceful world
with your own hands, is that it?
m920240.――だから、わかりやすく行こうぜ。\n俺様は平和な世界ってやつが大好きだ。\nそ:
――So, let's keep it simple.
I love a peaceful world.
And for that, you need the strongest king.
m920240.――だが、あと一歩足りてねぇ。\nこれで終わりだぜ。:
—But you're still one step short.
This ends it.
m920240.――って、あ、あら？\n車軸がきしんで――きゃああああぁっ！？:
—Wait, oh, oh no?
The axle is creaking—KYAAAAAA!?
m920240.――というわけで、志願者で\n観測隊を結成することになったのですが……。:
—So, since we have volunteers,
we've formed an observation team…
m920240.――やるねぇ。\n見直したよ、王子サマ。:
――Not bad.
I've got a new respect for you, Prince.
m920240.――よいしょー。\nふぅ、通路安定してます。\n全員そのまま、落ち着いて通過して:
――Heave-ho.
Phew, the passage is stable.
Everyone, please proceed calmly as is.
m920240.――よぉ、久しぶりだな。\nと言っても、お前に会ったのは、\n俺がもうすぐ死ぬっ:
—Well, long time no see.
Though the last time I saw you,
I was about to die.
m920240.――アトナテス。\n未来を考えたことは？:
—Atnates.
Have you ever thought about the future?
m920240.――アンブローズ様、\nこちらの攻撃が吸い寄せられています。:
I recognize that trick!
Prince, that's a rift in spacetime!
m920240.――ギルガメッシュ。\n王国は二度と、敗北しない。\nたとえ相手が誰であろうとも:
――Gilgamesh.
The Kingdom will never fall again.
No matter who stands against us.
m920240.――ゴブリン軍団の躍進ハ、\nひとりの献身にヨルものではナイ。:
――The Goblin Legion's progress
is not due to the dedication of just one person.
m920240.――ッはぁ！ はぁ、あー……疲れた。\nで、誰が敗北しただって？:
—Hah! Hah, ah…… I'm exhausted.
So, who got defeated?
m920240.――モリグナンと、トリステラの存在が、\nわずかな可能性も消すべきではないと示し:
――But the existence of Morigan and Tristella shows
that even a slim possibility shouldn't be dismissed.
m920240.――モードリオン。\n英雄王が拾った孤児であり、彼の義理の息子。:
—Modrion.
An orphan picked up by the Hero King, and his adopted son.
m920240.――今は、ぶちのめしたくて仕方がねぇ。:
…Right now, I just want to crush him.
--- scene: The Masked King ---
m920240.――作戦目標を説明するよ。: ――Let me outline the objectives of our operation.
m920240.――分かった。\nもういい。クソ兄貴、もう黙れよ。:
—Got it.
That's enough. Shut up, you bastard of a brother.
m920240.――創造神の求めた世界。\nその後継者こそ、この者たち、か。:
——The world the Creator God sought.
And his successors are these people, I see.
m920240.――力を。\n理想の世界をもたらすための、\nすべてを斬り伏せる、真に強き力を。:
—Power.
The truly mighty power to cut down all obstacles
and bring about the ideal world.
m920240.――姉御、奴は王国の王子です。\n噂によれば魔王と神を討った者だとか。:
――Boss, he's the Prince of the Kingdom.
Rumor has it he slew the Demon King and a god.
m920240.――我が王。\n拠点内部に王国軍が侵入しました。\nどうやらガルヴェインは敗北し:
—My King.
The Kingdom's army has breached the base.
It seems Galwain has been defeated.
m920240.――我が臣下、モードリオン。\n我が失われた神の名において力を与える。:
—My subject, Modurion.
In the name of my lost god, I grant you power.
m920240.――新しい物語が、始まるんだなって。\nなんとなく、そう思ったんだ。:
——I just felt like a new story is about to begin.
That's all.
m920240.――溶けちまえ。\nこれが星の物語、最初の記憶だッ！！:
—Melt.
This is the first memory of the star's story!!
--- scene: The First Divine Wedge ---
m920240.――王子くんの誓いを、\nしっかりと、その目で見たからですよ。:
――Lord Ambrose,
our attacks are being drawn away.
m920240.――理解など不要。\n我が王！ 破壊の神よ！\n世界の再誕は、いまここから始まる:
—Understanding is unnecessary.
My King! God of Destruction!
The rebirth of the world begins here, now!
m920240.――神ですら、迷うものだ。\n決して間違えないものなど、この世界に存在しない。:
—Even gods waver.
There is nothing in this world that never makes a mistake.
m920240.――私の願いは、ご主人様を支え続けること。\nいずれ世界を担うご主人様の前に立ち:
—My wish is to continue supporting my master.
To be a maid capable of clearing away every obstacle
that stands before my master, who will one day bear the world on their shoulders.
m920240.――私の願いは、王子の守護者であること。\n輝ける未来にたどり着き、それを永遠と:
—My wish is to be the Prince's guardian.
To keep protecting my future king with the Divine Spear
until we reach a brilliant future and make it eternal.
m920240.――騎士ガルヴェイン。\nここからは手抜きなしで行くぜ？:
—Galwain, the Knight.
No more holding back from here on, alright?
m920240.――騎士隊、抜剣ッ！\n接近戦になります。迎え撃てッ！！:
――Cavalry, draw your swords!
Prepare for close combat! Hold them off!!
m920240.…………ぜぇ、はぁ。\nあー……ちくしょう、全部終わった後かよ。:
……Hah, hah.
Ah…… damn it, is this over?
m920240.…………死してなお、言葉を紡ぐとはな。\nなるほど、これが人類の英雄か。:
…………Even in death, you weave words.
I see. So this is a hero of humanity.
m920240.……あとで爆殺してやりますよぉ。\nこき使ったあとでペタルカスケードですよぉ。:
……I'll blow you to smithereens later.
After I've used you up, I'll hit you with a Petal Cascade.
m920240.……あなたの頑丈さには驚かされます。\nトラムの銀腕をまともに喰らって、よく無事:
……Your durability never ceases to amaze me.
You took Tram's silver arm head-on and are still unharmed.
m920240.……あなたは、簡単に人を信じすぎです。\nどうせもう、あの王子をどうやって王にす:
……You trust people too easily.
You're probably having a grand time scheming about how to make that Prince a king, aren't you?
m920240.……あー。\nそっか、私たち、伝令を追い抜いちゃったんだ。:
……Ah.
Right, we just passed the messenger.
m920240.……いいえ。\n過去は過去です、我が王。:
……No.
The past is the past, my King.
m920240.……いや、わかんねぇな。\n平和な時代なんてものを、\n味わったことすらないんだ:
……No, I don't get it.
I've never even tasted what a peaceful age is like.
m920240.……うん。よく、覚えてる。\nあれは英雄王の言葉だった。:
Haa, seriously…….
He left everything to us and just left.
m920240.……おい、エンキドゥ。\nもうやめとけよ。\nそいつの中身、あの男じゃねぇんだろ:
……Hey, Enkidu.
Quit it already.
The person inside him isn't that guy, is it?
m920240.……おふたりは結局、どっちについたんです？: ……So, which side did you two end up on, in the end?
m920240.……ご主人様、下がってください。\n何か仕掛けてきます。:
……Master, please step back.
He's about to make his move.
m920240.……そういう態度が気に入らねぇんだよ。\n何もかも、自分の思い通りにしようって態:
……I hate that attitude.
The way you try to make everything go your way.
m920240.……それは、今までどおりでお願いできませんか？: ……Could we perhaps stick to the usual arrangement?
m920240.……ったく。騎士の戦いに、\n神の残りカスごときが口出ししてんじゃねぇよ。:
??? : ……Damn it. Don't you dare interfere
in a knight's battle with some leftover scraps of a god.
m920240.……ですね。\nあの白き、導きとは……いったい何だったのでしょうか。:
……Yes.
That white guidance… what exactly was it?
m920240.……では、姉さん。\n改めてあなたを頼らせてください。\nこの戦いの間だけ、手を:
……Then, sister.
Please allow me to entrust you with this, once more.
I need your help for the duration of this battle.
m920240.……どうして彼女たちも一緒に来ているんですか？: ...Why are they coming along with us?
m920240.……どうせ、人は争うぜ？\nあいつの理想は叶えてやりたいが、\nそれでも、今の時:
……People will always fight, won't they?
I want to see his ideal come true,
but even in this era, there are villains.
m920240.……はぁ。\n何度言えば分かるのですか、ガルヴェイン。\n父上をクソ野郎呼ばわり:
……Sigh.
How many times must I say this, Galwain?
Stop calling Father a bastard.
m920240.……ふふっ。\nまだ答えにたどり着いていないのなら、\nこの計画、私たちの勝ちで:
……Heh.
If you still haven't figured it out,
then this plan is already a win for us.
m920240.……ふふっ。ところで、\nずっと聞きたかったことを、質問してもいいですか？:
……Heh. By the way,
may I ask you something I've been dying to know?
m920240.……やっぱり、ですか。: ……I see. So that's how it is.
m920240.……エンキドゥ、いや、モードリオン。\nお前はなぜ、そうまでして世界に命を捧ぐ。:
……Enkidu, no, Modurion.
Why do you devote yourself to the world so completely?
m920240.……ギルガメッシュに、\nふたりの英傑が一時的にとはいえ\n協力していたという事:
……The fact that Gilgamesh
was temporarily aided by those two heroes.
m920240.……グングニル、いや、\n終焉要塞ゼウスと似た力を感じる。:
...Gungnir, no...
I feel a power similar to the Fortress of the End, Zeus.
m920240.……フム。\nゴブリン軍団ヨ！ 訓練は一時中断スル！:
……Hm.
Goblin Corps!
Training is suspended for the moment!
m920240.……フラガラッハ。ロンゴミニアド。\nそれから英傑連中の神器に、エクスカリバー。:
……Falgala. Llongbiniad.
And the heroes' divine artifacts, including Excalibur.
m920240.……ミレイユ様。\nとんでもないことを仰っているという、\nその自覚はありますか:
……Mireille.
Are you aware of just how
absurd that claim is?
m920240.……モリグナン、不服ですけど、\n今は少しだけ協力してもらえますか。:
……Morignan, I'm not thrilled about this, but
could you lend us a hand for a little while?

m920240.そこの二人と、同じさ……。\n英雄王が、帰ってくる……。\nそんな口車に乗せられ:
Same as those two over there…….
The Hero King is coming back…….
That's the kind of bait I fell for, and look where it got me.
m920240.そして、王子。\n君が成し遂げたことは、聞いている。:
And, Prince.
I have heard of what you have accomplished.
m920240.そして、英雄王が\n未来にどれだけの可能性を残したか！:
And the Hero King…
how many possibilities he left for the future!
m920240.そして数多の神器が、\n各国の王位継承者のもとにあるように。:
And so that countless other divine artifacts
would reside with the heirs to the thrones of various nations.
m920240.そして生まれ変わった世界こそ、\n我が父が再び目覚めるに\nふさわしい場所である:
And this reborn world is the only place
worthy of my father's awakening.
m920240.そのための、この大戦力ですからね！\n北部城塞はこの日のために\nあったと言って:
Which is exactly why we have this massive army!
It's no exaggeration to say the Northern Fortress
exists for a day like this.
m920240.そのとおり。\nでは今の時代に、もうひとつ、\n足りないものがあるとは思わないか:
That's correct.
Then don't you think there is one more thing
missing from this era?
m920240.その中でも、王子は本当に困った人です。\n自分の手の届かない場所で起きた悲劇まで:
And among them, the Prince is truly a troublemaker.
He suffers and struggles as if it were his own tragedy,
even for tragedies that happen beyond his reach……
m920240.その全ての時代で、人類は殺し合い続けていた。\n一瞬の平和があったとしても、\n:
In every single era, humanity was locked in endless slaughter.
Even if a moment of peace was found, it was swiftly shattered by invaders.
m920240.その原因は、明白でしょう。:
――Because he saw the Prince's oath
with his own eyes, clearly and truly.
m920240.その愚かな理想論をかざした神に、\n地上を焼かれた者の言葉に、説得力はありません:
There is no conviction in the words of a god
who waved that foolish idealism,
and burned the surface of the earth.
m920240.その手は見覚えありますよぉ！\n王子ちゃん、あれは時空の間隙です！:
Ranged attacks will be pulled in, so
please command accordingly.
m920240.その望み次第では、\n戦闘を回避することも不可能ではないでしょう。:
Depending on what we find,
it may not be impossible to avoid combat.
m920240.その過ちを正すためには、\nそれを征するだけの力が必要なのだと！:
And that to correct that mistake,
one needs the power to conquer it!
m920240.それからモードリオン、\nアトナテス、君たちは強い子だ。\n自分の道は自分で選び:
And Modurion,
Atnates, you are strong children.
Choose your own paths.
m920240.それがまさか、とんでもない国宝の運搬と、\n騎竜を最前線に運ぶ任務だったなんて。:
I never expected it would mean transporting a
national treasure, and escorting a dragon rider to the front lines.
m920240.それが蓋を開けてみりゃ、中身が全くの別人と来た。\nその上、抗ってくんのがただの:
And when the lid is lifted, the contents are a completely different person.
On top of that, the one resisting him is just a Prince!
m920240.それが誓いか。\n王国とは、お前と仲間たちの手が届く全て。\n助けを求める全ての:
Is that a vow?
The Kingdom is everything within your reach, you and your companions.
It is all the people who call for help.
m920240.それでは、約束でしたね？\n名を名乗ってもらいましょうか。:
Then, we have a deal, yes?
Please, tell us your names.
m920240.それで値踏みの結果は？\n我らがギルガメッシュは王の器なりや？:
So, what's the verdict?
Is our Gilgamesh fit to be a king?
m920240.それに、その仮面がある限り、\nあなたが誰だったのか、\nそれを認識することなん:
Besides, as long as you're wearing that mask,
no one can recognize who you really are,
can they?
m920240.それに、アンブローズで\n遊んでいる暇があるんですか？\nあなたにとっては、千年:
Besides, do you really have time to play with Ambrose?
For you, this is a spectacle you haven't seen in a thousand years.
m920240.それに、堅苦しい式典服で\n身体がばっきばきになってますしね……。:
Besides, my body is stiff from wearing
that stiff ceremonial attire……
m920240.それは、人類が平和を謳歌し、\n優れた技術と精神をもって大いに繁栄した時代。:
It was an age when humanity enjoyed peace,
and flourished greatly with superior technology and spirit.
m920240.そんなことは、私が一番よく知っています。: I know that better than anyone.
m920240.そんなものは、時を彷徨い、\n嘆きの声を聞き続けたあのときに、もう決まっています:
I made that decision long ago,
while wandering through time, listening to the cries of lament.
m920240.そんな時代を、共に作っていくのですよ。: We will create such an age, together.
m920240.ただ、これはお前の計画に乗るわけじゃない。\nお前の頼みだから、聞いてやる。それ:
Just don't think this means I'm on board with your plan.
I'm doing this because you asked. That's all.
m920240.だから――偽りを、真実にする必要がある。: That is why—I must turn falsehood into truth.
m920240.だから、やり直すことにしたと？\nだが、時の破片に\n過去のすべてをやり直すだけ:
So you decided to start over?
But the shards of time shouldn't have the power to rewrite the entire past.
m920240.だから、精一杯を尽くして、死んでいったんです。\nそのあとの時代のことを、人々に:
And so, he gave his all and died.
Leaving the era that followed to the people.
m920240.だから、討伐することを念頭に置きつつ、\nもしかしたら対話の余地が残されているか:
So, while we keep elimination in mind,
there might still be room for dialogue
――is that correct, Yoki?
m920240.だからこそ、あの捻くれ者たちも、\n父上を放っておけないのでしょうね。:
That is likely why those stubborn ones
cannot leave Father alone.
m920240.だから王子、対話は仮面の破壊が前提条件。\nあくまでボクは、仲間の安全と、\n確:
So, Prince, dialogue is only possible if the masks are destroyed.
I'll always choose the safety of my comrades
and a guaranteed victory.
m920240.だが――足りねぇよ。\nそれじゃあ世界ってやつを守ることはできねぇ。:
But――it's not enough.
That won't be enough to protect the world.
m920240.だが、それに何の意味がある？\nいったい何を企んでいるんだ。:
But what's the point?
What exactly are you planning?
m920240.だめです！\n専門家の言うことはきいてくださーい！:
No way!
Please listen to the expert!
m920240.ちっ……この仮面、便利だが\nこういう時に気が利かねぇな……。:
Tch… this mask is handy, but
it's useless when it matters most…
m920240.ちっ……こんなところで故障か？\n魔物の生息域のど真ん中だぞ！:
Tch… a breakdown right here?
We're right in the middle of monster territory!
m920240.ちっ……なんだ、こいつら……！\nさっきまでとは別人じゃねぇか！:
Tch... what are these things...!
They're not the same as before!
m920240.ちっ……冗談まで言えるのかよ、あの偽物。\nまるで人間みたいに笑いやがって。:
Tch… Can that fake even crack a joke?
Laughing just like a human.
m920240.ちっ……生き返ったばかりの俺に容赦ねぇな。\nまじで……殺す気かよ……。:
Tch…… No mercy for a guy who just crawled back from the dead?
Seriously…… are you trying to kill me or what?
m920240.ちっ……見覚えがありすぎるぜ。:
Prince, that's a crystal of healing magic.
It's his――the Hero King's power.
m920240.ちっ、攻撃の意志だけはありそうだ。\n仕方ない、迎撃するぞ！:
Tch, it at least seems to have the will to attack.
Fine, let's engage!
m920240.ちょうどいい。\nエレイン、一度馬を休ませろ。\n目的地は目の前だし、馬もそろそ:
Perfect timing.
Elaine, let the horses rest for a bit.
Our destination is right ahead, and the horses are nearing their limit.
m920240.ちょっと、もう新作の執筆してるの？\n今度こそ、王子の英雄譚は私の方が先に歌うか:
Hey, are you already writing a new piece?
This time, I'm going to sing the Prince's hero tale before you do.
m920240.つまり、お前らの言う死にぞこない。\n――英傑ってやつさ。:
In other words, I'm one of those "dead heroes"
you lot talk about.
m920240.つまり逆説的に、私たちが\nその変化を感じていないということは、\nこっちの知ら:
So, by contradiction, the fact that we don't feel
any change means an event unknown to us
has been rewritten.
m920240.では失礼を承知で。\nミレイユ様は、いったいおいくつなのですか？:
Well, forgive my impertinence.
Just how old are you, Mireille?
m920240.でも……この神剣だけは、\n王国にも秘した上で、北の大国が守り続けてきたわ。:
But... this divine sword alone was
kept secret even from the Kingdom, and guarded by the Northern Great Power.
m920240.でも、ちょっと安心した顔してましたね？: The reason for that is obvious.
m920240.でも、やりがいはあるでしょ？\n最前線で戦ってる王子に、\n何が何でもこれを届け:
But isn't it worth it?
We have to get this to the Prince
fighting on the front lines, no matter what!
m920240.でも、助力しに来たのは嘘ではありません。\n――貴方がたの哀しみを奏でましょう。:
But it's not a lie that I came to help.
――Let us play your sorrow.
m920240.でもセーラ、あなたの主のそんな姿を見て、\n手が届かないのなら、代わりにそこまで:
But Sarah, seeing your Master like that,
comrades gathered who thought, "If I can't reach him,
I'll run there in his place."
m920240.と、飛んでいきました！\nあんな重装甲の騎士が一瞬で地平線の向こうに！？:
She flew off!
A knight in heavy armor, sent past the horizon in an instant!?
m920240.どうした、何か問題か？: What's wrong? Is there a problem?
m920240.どうせ、もう隠し通せないですよ？\nそれに……自分から名乗らないと、\nその仮面:
You can't keep it hidden forever, can you?
Besides…… if you don't say it yourself,
there's someone who's going to rip that mask off you by force.
m920240.どうせなら、特等席で見るべきでしょう？: If we're going to see it, we should have a front-row seat, don't you think?
m920240.どうぞどうぞ。\nこちらはクオリティで勝負します。:
Please do.
I'll compete on quality.
m920240.なぁ、公爵。\nいったいあの儀式で、何を持ち出したんだ。:
Hey, Duchess.
What exactly did you bring out of that ceremony?
m920240.なぜ、生きているのでしょう……？\n確かに私は、この身を焼き尽くされたはずですが:
Why am I still alive…?
I should have been burned to ashes.
m920240.ならば、見せてあげましょう。\nこの世界は、その始まりから過ちだったのだと。:
Then, let me show you.
That this world was a mistake from the very beginning.
m920240.ならば見せてもらおう。\nこの肉体が夢見た、人類の未来の姿を。:
Then let me see.
The future of humanity that this body dreamed of.
m920240.なるほど、ここで仕留めるつもりだったみたいだね。\nなかなかの大軍勢だ。\nでも:
I see. They intended to finish us off right here.
Quite a large army, isn't it?
But the enemy has misjudged our combat power.
m920240.なるほど、その騎士に忠義を誓ったんだね。\nそれなら――容赦はしないよ。:
I see. You've sworn loyalty to that Knight.
Then――I won't hold back.
m920240.なるほど、では急ぎ斬りすてましょう。\n王子様、そちらはお任せします。:
I see. Then let us cut it down swiftly.
Prince, I'll leave that side to you.
m920240.なるほど、確かに。\nまるでこの男の記憶を見ているかのようだ。:
I see. Indeed.
It's as if I'm seeing this man's memories.
m920240.なんだあれは……。\n魔力の塊、なのか？:
What is that...
A mass of mana, perhaps?
m920240.なんだその子どもの理屈。: What kind of childish logic is that?
m920240.なんということを……。: What kind of thing is that…
m920240.はぁ……。\nエヴェリーナ様に言われて、\n気軽に手伝いを請け負いましたけど……:
Haa…
I agreed to help on a whim
because Your Grace asked me to, but…
m920240.はぁ、ふたりとも落ち着きなさい！\n父上を呼びますよ！？:
Sigh, both of you, calm down!
Father is calling us!
m920240.はぁ、まったく……。\n全部託していきやがったな、あいつ。: That's how he was, even when he died.
m920240.はぁ、休憩だと思ったのにー！: Haa, I thought we were taking a break!
m920240.はぁぁ……アトナテスさんの\nヴァリトスちゃんに乗せてもらえばよかったぁ……。\:
Haaah… I should've just ridden with Atnates
on Valitos-chan…
My bottom is gonna split in four with this shakinguuu.
m920240.はいはい、お仕事しましょうねー。\nそろそろ冗談をいう余裕もなくなってきたのでー:
Right!
Prince, let's go all out!
m920240.はっ……されど、すべては過去のこと。\n御身なき世界に未来などありません。:
Hah…… Yet, all of that is in the past.
There is no future in a world without Your Majesty.
m920240.ははっ。大丈夫ですよ。\n父上と仲間たちが全員揃っていれば、\nきっと、この世界:
Haha. It will be fine.
As long as Father and all our companions are together,
we will surely be able to guide this world correctly.
m920240.はんっ……好きにしろよ。\n全部失敗しても、俺様が代わりに\n全世界をぶちのめし:
Hmph…… Do whatever you want.
Even if it all fails, I'll just smash the whole world myself
and force everyone to kneel.
m920240.はんっ、やっぱりお前だったか。\nモリグナンの仮面も完璧じゃねぇな。:
Hmph. So that's who you really are.
Your disguise as Morignan wasn't even perfect.
m920240.ひとつは、世界を滅ぼす巨悪を倒すこと。\n誰にもできない偉業を成し遂げて、\n有:
First, defeat the great evil that threatens to destroy it.
Accomplish a feat no one else can,
and become the king that all must obey.
m920240.ふぅ。そういうわけで、\nおふたりには「当代の英傑」として、\nしばらく民衆の憧:
Phew. So, for the time being, I'd like you two to be regarded as the "Heroes of the Age,"
to be the people the populace looks up to.
m920240.ふふ、ミレイユ様らしくもない。\nもっと堂々としていてください。:
Fufu, that's not very like you, Mireille.
Please be more composed.
m920240.ふふっ、ではそうしておきます。: Heh, very well, I'll leave it at that.
m920240.ふふっ、悪いことばかりではないと思いますので。: Heh, I don't think it's all bad, you know.
m920240.ふむふむ、どれどれ……？\nって、おい、王都警備隊が志願してちゃだめだろ。\n王:
Mm, let's see…
Wait, you can't have the Capital Guard volunteering.
The capital will be left wide open.
m920240.へぇ、この仮面、そこまで便利な代物だったのか。\n確かにお前は昔から、\nこうい:
Hm. So this mask is that useful, huh.
I knew you had a taste for this kind of
tacky magic, ever since we were kids.
m920240.へぇ、安心したぜ。\n俺を覚えてるってことは、\nてめぇの中身は別人だったりしね:
Heh, that puts my mind at ease.
If you remember me, that means
you're still the same person on the inside.
m920240.ほう、消し飛ばなかったか。\nこんなに面白いやつらがいるなら、\nこの時代のこと:
Hmph, you didn't get blown away.
If there are people this entertaining,
I should have looked into this era more thoroughly.
m920240.ま、到着すればわかるさ。: Well, we'll see once we get there.
m920240.まぁ、いいや。\nお前がついていて、\nそれでも人類は戦争をやめられなかった。:
Well, whatever.
Even with you by his side,
humanity couldn't stop the wars.
m920240.まぁ、こうなってしまうのではないか、とは。\nですがそれも、ある意味では\nセー:
Well, it might turn out that way.
But in a sense, it might end up being exactly
what Sarah wanted.
m920240.まぁいいさ。\n昔馴染みの連中も、ようやくここへたどり着いたようだ。\n盛大にぶ:
Whatever.
It seems the old crew has finally made it here too.
Let's crush them in style!
m920240.まぁまぁ。\nリッカさんのお尻には\n癒しの魔法をかけておきますから。:
Now, now.
I'll cast a soothing spell on your bottom,
so don't worry about it.
m920240.まず、最も確実性の高い手段。\nエンキドゥ、ギルガメッシュの討伐だ。:
First, the most reliable course of action.
We eliminate Enkidu and Gilgamesh.
m920240.まだ、ディアスの理想論の方が説得力がありましたね。\n彼は人を愚かと断じながらも:
Dias's idealism had more conviction than that.
Even while judging people as foolish,
he had the kindness to bet on their potential.
m920240.まったく、馬鹿みたいだぜ。\n千年戦争で死んだ奴のことを、\nこっちはずっと後悔:
Seriously, this is ridiculous.
We've been carrying the guilt over the ones who died in the Millennium War this whole time, and…
m920240.まったくだ。\nこんな正装に着替えろなんて、\nいったい何の封印を解く儀式なんだ:
Exactly.
Whoever ordered us to change into such formal wear
must have been performing some kind of unsealing ritual……
m920240.もうひとつは、世界を滅ぼす巨悪になること。\n誰も逆らえない力を手にすれば、\n:
Or, become the great evil that threatens to destroy the world.
If you wield a power no one can defy,
everyone will give up on resisting.
m920240.やっぱり、こうじゃないと。: I knew it. This is the way.
m920240.ようやく理解したぜ。\nそれなら、なおさら急いで届けてやらねぇとな。:
I finally get it.
If that's the case, I need to hurry and deliver it.
m920240.よし、調査だ！ 王子さま！\n調査許可！ いますぐ！:
Alright, investigation time! Prince!
I request permission to investigate! Immediately!
m920240.よし、越境要塞からの馬車も合流した。\nこのまま最前線まで駆け抜けるぞ。:
Good. The carriage from the border fortress has joined us.
Let's push through to the front lines.
m920240.よせよ、お前が姉さん姉さんうるさいから、\n本当の姉弟だって勘違いされたの思い出:
Stop it. You keep calling me "sister" so much,
I'm starting to remember how people used to mistake us for real siblings.
m920240.わっ、わっ、皆さん、ストップ！\n撤退！ 撤退を進言しまーす！:
Wa, wa, everyone, stop!
Retreat! I'm recommending a retreat!
m920240.ん、なんだ……？\nゴブリン軍団か？:
Hm, what is this……?
The Goblin Legion?
m920240.アイリーン、そんなに慌てふためくなんて、\nあなたらしくありませんよ。\nもっと:
Irene, panicking like that is
not at all like you.
Please act more like the mastermind you are.
m920240.アトナテス。\nまだ、私を兄と呼んでくれるのですね。\n――ついてきなさい。あな:
Atnates.
You still call me your brother.
—Come with me. You have the right to know.
m920240.アヴァロンは英雄王に、\n過去から未来、すべての王であることを望み――:
Avalon wished for the Hero King to be
the ruler of all ages, past and future—
m920240.イマも戦い続けるモノ、後方ニテ支え続けるモノ、\nソシテ、数多の戦いデ散っていっ:
It is thanks to those who continue to fight,
those who continue to support from the rear,
and those who fell in countless battles……
It is thanks to all the Goblin race!!
m920240.ウムッ！ メカゴブリンクイーン様の存在ハ、\n我らになくてはならヌ、\n最も重要:
Mm-hm! The presence of our Mech Goblin Queen
is something we cannot do without,
the most important and noble thing of all!
m920240.エンキドゥには、感謝しないといけないかしら。\nこれから楽しいことが起きますよな:
Perhaps I should be grateful to Enkidu.
He told me that something exciting was about to happen.
m920240.エヴェリーナ、無事に戻ったのね。\n――神剣は？:
Evelina, you've returned safely.
—And the divine sword?
m920240.エヴェリーナ公爵！\nはい、修理完了です！:
Duchess Evelina!
Yes, the repairs are complete!
m920240.カッコつけて解説してあげてもいいけど、\nここは我慢しておくわね♪ って意味だと:
I suppose I could put on a show and explain it for you,
but I'll hold back for now♪ That's what I think she meant.
m920240.ガル、ヴェイン……。\n私は……どうすれば……。:
Gal……wain…….
What…… am I supposed to do……?
m920240.ガルヴェイン、あとは私が。\n我が王の望む世界は、すぐ近くに迫っています。:
Galwain, I'll take it from here.
The world our King desires is just around the corner.
m920240.ガルヴェインは、永遠の命を望まなかったのです。\nゆえに、この場には存在するはず:
Galwain did not seek eternal life.
Therefore, he should not exist in this place.
m920240.ガルヴェイン！\n頭を冷やしてもらうつもりだったけれど、\nどうやら無駄だったみ:
Galwain!
I was hoping you'd cool your head,
but it seems that was in vain.
m920240.ゲートの中に通路を展開して、\n無理やり安定化させました。\n今回ばかりはグリム:
I deployed a passage inside the gate
and forcibly stabilized it.
You can praise Grimm-chan for this one, you know.
m920240.コールブランドの鞘までここにあるのに、\nエクスカリバーの担い手がいないのはおか:
With the scabbard of Colbrand right here,
it's strange that there's no one to bear Excalibur.
m920240.サラナル未来のタメ！\nイザ！ 本日モ行軍クンレンを開始スル！！:
For a future yet to come!
Now then! Let's begin today's marching drill!!
m920240.シカシ、メカゴブリンクイーン様からハ、\n本日コノ行軍クンレンに向けテ、\nコノ:
However, our Mech Goblin Queen
bestowed upon us these words

Sarah, are you hurt?
After being hit by an attack like that...
m920240.ソラス様が、そうおっしゃるのであれば……。: If Your Highness Solais says so, then……

That's a story for after the world is at peace.
Right now, we're allies working together!
Come on, let's go!!
m920240.ディアスとの戦いにおいて、\n王国軍はかなりの被害を受けたままです。\n避けられ:
The Royal Army is still reeling from the heavy losses

If a fight can be avoided, it should be.
m920240.ディアスは、おそろしいものを遺していきましたね。: Dias left behind something truly terrifying.

Tram, look at you, all soft and gentle.
The invincible War God who drove humanity to the battlefield

Tram, what are you... Hah!?
Why is my fist—ow! Gwaaahhhhh!?

Lady Tram, Lady Meireu,

Who is she?
m920240.ニミュエぇ！ その解説はあたしがぁ！？:
Yes, yes, let's get to work.
We're running out of time for jokes.

Haha, it's of no consequence.
From this world's perspective,

m920240.ミレイユさんとセーラさんのことで――\n神器が――実質的に――ですから――。:
About Mireille and Sarah—
The divine artifacts—essentially—
m920240.ムムッ……？\n狭間の雪原でナニか起きているノカ？:
Mmuuh……?
Is something happening on the snowfield in between?

Baaah!!
I know those cavalry, baaah!!
The ones who cut down our young warriors, baaah!!

Morignan!
Where have you been off to all this time?

Modurion, that man was truly,

Yuugen, is something wrong?
You look like you're having fun.
m920240.ユージェン！\nゲートが不安定になっています！ 急いで！:
Yuugen!
The gate is becoming unstable! Hurry!
m920240.リリアがエクスカリバーを持つように。: So that Lilia would possess Excalibur.
m920240.リリア殿下！？\nそれに、あの軍勢は……。:
Princess Lilia!?
And that army is……
m920240.一度死にかけたのに、\n魔力だか何かで無理やり再生したんだろう？\n急ぎ検査をす:
You were on the brink of death, and then somehow forcibly regenerated by magic or whatever.
We need to run tests immediately! Medics and healers, assemble!

Fail.
I can't entrust my war to a contract
based on an uncertain wish.

That's impertinent, Galwain.
My King, please forgive my unworthy friend.
m920240.世界の再誕とやらを見せてくれるんだろ？\n俺様が飽きるまでは、付き合ってやるよ。:
You're going to show us this “rebirth of the world,” right?
I'll stick around until I get bored.
So――move it! Let's go!
m920240.世界を守るために必要な条件は、分かるか？: Do you understand what it takes to protect the world?
m920240.世界を渡るんだ。\nこの先の世界へ、破壊神を追って。:
Cross over the world.
To the world beyond, in pursuit of the God of Destruction.
m920240.中には、テミスのガラティンのように、\n砕け散った破片から打ち直されたものや――:
Some, like Themis's Galatine,
were reforged from shattered fragments, and—

Never again shall this world
endure the repeated moments of destruction—

A person... no, I sense no life force.
How to put it... like a hollow shell...

Humanity is truly a foolish species.

m920240.人類同士で争い、殺戮を繰り返し、\n平和が訪れたかと思えば、今度は抗う力を失い、:
They quarreled among themselves, repeating cycles of slaughter.
When peace finally arrived, they lost the strength to resist,
and in the end, they were easily trampled by the Demon King.
m920240.今の私に、そこまでの力はありません。\n以前の戦いで、ギルガメッシュに\n無理や:
??? : I don't have that kind of power right now.
In the previous battle, Gilgamesh
forcibly tore that power away from me.

This side, I guess?
Rashmash said we absolutely can't miss
a turning point in history.

I can no longer hear its voice,
yet I can still feel a faint warmth
coming from my weapon.

Call me Gilgamesh, for now.
It is the name my subjects wished for me.
m920240.今度こそ、どこへだって駈けつけるさ。\n君の手が届かない場所にだって。:
This time, we'll run to any place.
Even to where your hand can't reach.
m920240.今度こそ、兜をきらきらさせながらな？: This time, with our helmets shining bright, right?

I suppose there's no choice…
Please provide escort until the carriage is repaired!

In a previous incident involving a historical alteration,
it was determined that those who witnessed the event
could retain the altered memories.

If that power is what
caused the meteors to rain down on the earth—

According to legend, yes……

of receiving a divine sword from Avalon is the Hero King.

……Yeah. I remember them well.
Those were the Hero King's words.

Shine bright, and scorch the entire earth.
—My holy blade! Galatiin!!

To rewrite the world of the God of Creation,
it is time to set sail for the forgotten world that no longer exists!
m920240.創造神の被造物では不可能なのであれば、\n破壊神の揺るぎなき力で。:
If it is impossible for the creations of the God of Creation,
then it will be done by the unshakable power of the God of Destruction.

The warriors of the Northern Fortress and the Border Fortress…
how many reckless battles they have won.

The northern exploration, the alliances with so many villages,
and the battles against the threats in the north……
Everyone's morale is higher than ever.

Even if it's dangerous, even if it's tough,
going to a new world

Same here.

But since it's not――there's no story of the future there.

You're quite the romantic yourself.
Getting this worked up over an ideal that doesn't even exist.

Take this, the primordial flame.
The fire of the beginning, the god's crucible.

You're a troublesome little brother.

—Fine. I'll lend you a hand.

that he paced the study all day,
until Ambrose was completely exasperated.

If we shatter his mask,
those lost memories should return.

Bandits, thieves…
Heh, I hope they aren't mistaking this for a picnic.

We can't get our ceremonial robes dirty.
Let's just give them a light response.

Archers, provide support!
The Northern Great Power's finest are showing their true strength now!

We'll need archers too…?
In case we can't get back, we'll have to hunt for food.

It's a battle of vengeance, I'll show you!!
You can't just do whatever you want on the snowfields!!

The strong should lead the world.
If you're just fooling around without that resolve,
I'm done helping you out of obligation.

I feel a strong healing power.
The enemies are recovering rapidly!

or the gods wield their power,
or ancient relics that could destroy the world awaken—

His idea of "exciting" and what you're seeing now as "exciting"…

We only have a fragmentary understanding of their goals.
Based on what Rashmash and Zizi have told us――

Wait, Enkidu.
Isn't it about time you revealed who you are?

Wait, Galwain!

That's reassuring.
—Then, see you in that other world.

Patients always say that!
Aisha, please have them step back!

Sorry about that, Rikka.
I've got my hands full dealing with a real handful over here too.

Being loved too much is a nuisance, isn't it?
Oh, Tristella, the little frog is running away?

I've brought along the rascal from my duchy.
—a dragon rider. Please treat it well.

My son.

is the will to never give up.

Since it is the advice of my vassal's elder sister,
I shall comply.

We traveled together
only because of the radiance of you, my King.

Our Goblin Legion has survived countless battles!
And we're becoming a mighty force!

Hang in there!
I'm already picking the smoothest route I can find!

Even though they might not be able to return,
I'm surprised everyone is so eager to go.

Enemy details confirmed!
They're the Masked Army!
Under Gilgamesh's command!

In the past?
It wasn't quite that chaotic back then.

He used to go all out, back in the day.
He held back just now so he wouldn't kill me.

That's what I want!!
My Lord, the Knight of Flame, incarnation of the Sun!
We offer you our lives in victory!
m920240.未知の大地なら、騎兵も必要。\n足の速い原生生物もいるかもしれないし。:
If it's unknown territory, we'll need cavalry.
There might be fast-moving native creatures.

He really is a hopeless fool.
A great fool who refuses to let fate bend him.

I really think you shouldn't go.

We can't observe anything on the other side.
m920240.本日の行軍クンレンにハ、\n王国軍カラは、アミー殿ト、\nゴブリンブラザーズも駆:
For today's marching drill,
Amie-sama from the Royal Army

Normally, I'd be the one to shut down
any suggestion of talking with the enemy……

I can't tell if they're hesitating to stop us,
or if they're concentrating their forces
to make sure they finish us off……

Just because an ideal has never existed in history

Do not worry.
The memories remaining in this body

Father seems to believe in the potential of people,

Everyone volunteered immediately.
It would have been faster to count the ones who didn't want to go.

The people of the Snowfields Between…
how deeply they love this land.

Don't panic, you idiots.

Remember the promise to give us the best place to die.

Excalibur, the divine sword that chooses the king.

Ah, ah, ahhhh!?

The stories of the King of Heroes that remain in the Kingdom

They haven't changed since the day this kingdom was born.

You of the Kingdom, you're in a hurry, aren't you?

We'll see you off!!

The Kingdom's first mage, and the Kingdom's first witch.
We entrust their magic――

I can feel a strong healing power.
The enemies are recovering rapidly!

Prince, Lilia!
The enemy's encirclement is breaking!

Prince, this is a bit informal, but
I am bestowing upon you the national treasure of the Northern Great Power.

Prince, do not listen to him.

The rhetoric of a follower of ruin, guiding hearts toward war.

Prince!
The enemy is sending in reinforcements!

Prince-chan!
I'm spreading a buff spell around us!

Prince, I can see promise in you too.
I retract my earlier words.

Prince!
I'll hold off the enemies on the flank!
Please focus on the ones in front!

We were the ones who underestimated them...
But from here on—

We'll need healers too, right?
I'm currently selecting a few of the best.

How should I know!
Damn it, you're a real pain…….

Indeed, if you're carrying a legendary sword,

The Divine Wedge… no,
