m920240.神剣コールブランド。\nエクスカリバーの原型となった、\n物質界における最も古き:
The divine sword Colbrand.
I bestow upon you the oldest divine sword in the material plane,
the prototype of Excalibur.
m920240.私たちの計画を知れば、\nあなたもこちらへ来てくれるはずです。:
Once you learn about our plan,
you'll want to come to our side too.
m920240.私のフラガラッハのように、\n本来の力が封じられたものもあったけれど。:
Others, like my Fal Ghaladh,
had their true power sealed away.
m920240.私は、我が王と契約を交わしました。\nこの世界より失われし力の奪還と引き換えに、:
I have made a pact with my King.
In exchange for reclaiming the power lost from this world,
I will summon the true soul of my King back to this world.
m920240.私は、見たことがあります。\n北方の遺跡――古代の名残の地にて。\n奇妙な記録魔:
I have seen it.
At the ruins of the north—a place of ancient remnants.
The world's past, through a strange recording magic.
m920240.私は、魔王との決戦の折、\n時空の裂け目に落ち、\n無数の時代を渡り歩くことにな: During the decisive battle with the Demon King, I fell into a rift in spacetime and was forced to wander through countless eras.
m920240.私はただ、あなた方の願いの背中を押しただけ。\n死をも怖れぬ願いと、死地であろう:
I merely pushed you from behind.
A wish that fears not death, and a will that will not break even in the face of it.
I transformed that pure desire into a new power.
m920240.私は戦場を招く魔女。\n王に最高の戦場を贈ることこそ、我が使命。\nさぁトリステ:
I am a witch who summons battlefields.
It is my mission to gift the king the ultimate battlefield.
Come, Tristella. Play a melody worthy of legend.
m920240.私は行くからね？\nこんな機会、見逃せないもの。:
I'm going, of course.
I couldn't let a chance like this slip by.
m920240.笑えねぇ戦いだな、まったく。\nあいつが帰ってくるって言うから、\nわざわざ穏や:
This is a laughable battle, I tell you.
He said he'd come back, so I threw away
a peaceful death for nothing.
m920240.耐えきった……いや、違う……。\nこの力の感じは……。:
??? : You endured it… no, that's not it….
This power feels like…
m920240.自分から危険に突っ込んでいく手駒は多い方がいい。\nさて、まずは周辺に危険がない:
The more willing pawns I have to throw into danger, the better.
Now, I'd like to check for any immediate hazards in the area, but――
m920240.自分でカエルにしたんだから、\n最後の片付けまで自分でしてください。:
Since you turned it into a frog,
you can finish the cleanup yourself.
m920240.良かろう。\nならば、臣下の誓いに応えよう。:
Very well.
Then I shall answer the oath of my subject.
m920240.英傑の塔を建てるとき、\nあたしに隠れて\n変な機能いっぱい搭載したりもしてまし:
When we built the Tower of Heroes,
he secretly had me install
all sorts of strange features in it.
m920240.英雄王が守護者のひとり。\n聖剣ガラティンを賜りし、太陽を担う者。:
One of the Hero King's guardians.
The one who was granted the Holy Sword Galatin, the one who bears the sun.
m920240.英雄王の誰よりも近くで戦い続けた、\n紫竜の騎士たるあなたなら、分かるはずだ。:
You, who have fought by the Hero King's side
closer than anyone else, the Knight of the Purple Dragon,
should know.
m920240.英雄王は、そんな歪つな\n世界を目指してはいませんでしたよ。: The King of Heroes never aimed for such a twisted world.
m920240.裏切りとは失礼ですね。\n最初から味方したつもりはないですよ。:
"Defection" is a harsh word.
I never intended to be on their side to begin with.
m920240.要塞宮殿――いや、終焉要塞、ゼウス……？: The Fortress Palace――no, the Fortress of the End, Zeus...?
m920240.見事、生き延びてみせやがれ。\nこいつを耐えきったら、\nその時は仮面を外して、:
Show me you can survive this.
If you can endure this,
then I'll take off the mask and fight you fair and square.
m920240.計算外だったのは、\nふたりが思った以上のロマンティストだったことですが。:
The only thing I didn't calculate for was that the two of you
would turn out to be such hopeless romantics.
m920240.認識阻害を引き起こす仮面をつける前、\nモリグナンとトリステラに、\nエンキドゥ:
Before they donned the masks that induce cognitive interference,
what terms did Enkidu offer
Morigan and Tristella?
m920240.説明する必要はないぜ？\n俺はそこのトラムと同類。\nいや、一度死んでっから、ち:
No need for an explanation?
I'm of the same kind as that Tram over there.
Or maybe not, since I've died once?
m920240.誰も、英雄王にはなれなかった。\n自分の国を守るので精一杯。\nそんなくだらねぇ:
No one became the Hero King.
They were just busy defending their own lands.
I'm the one who'll put an end to that worthless world.
m920240.誰も彼も腹に一物抱えやがって。\n正体隠して、陰謀巡らせて、\nそんなの、何が楽:
Everyone's got an axe to grind.
Hiding who they are, spinning webs of conspiracy…
I don't get what the fun in that is.
m920240.起動している様子はないね。\nそれに、魔力もまったく感じられない。:
It doesn't appear to be active.
Besides, I can't sense any mana at all.
m920240.近衛とは王を守るもの。\n未来の我が王、あなたのためならば。:
A guard exists to protect the king.
For you, our future king.
m920240.追ってこい、創造神の子らよ。\n我が世界を――\n始まりの戦いを、その先で見せて:
Follow us, children of the Creator God.
My world――
I will show you the First Battle, and what lies beyond.
m920240.退屈でまた死にそうになってたところなんだ。\n王子、てめぇは楽しませてくれるんだ:
I was about to die of boredom again.
Prince, you'd better entertain me, huh?
m920240.遠距離攻撃は吸い寄せられてしまいますので、\nそれを踏まえて指揮をお願いします。: Nimue! I'm the one who explains!
m920240.重要な任務だから\n腕利きを向かわせてって\nシビラ殿下は言っていたけど……。: Her Highness Sibyl said we should send our best for such an important mission, but……
m920240.領地の視察に出たと思ったら、\n街の子どもたちに混じって一緒に遊んでいたとか。:
He would go out to inspect the territory,
only to be found playing with the local children.
m920240.魔法使いとしては、\n観測不能な世界の魔力とか気になるものね。:
As a mage,
I'm curious about the mana of a world that can't be observed.
m920240.魔王を倒した、そのあとのことです。\n父上は必ず、魔王を倒し、平和な世界を勝ち取:
About what comes after we defeat the Demon King.
Father will surely defeat the Demon King and win a peaceful world.
So we must think about what lies beyond that.
m920240.魔王城決戦です！\n女神の力には及びませんけど――:
The final battle at the Demon King's Castle!
It won't compare to the Goddess's power, but――
m920240.黒き破壊の力を奪われた、\nいわば、『白き導き』であるとでも名乗っておきましょう:
Stripped of the power of Black Destruction,
I suppose you could call me the 『White Guidance』.
m920240.黙らねぇよ。\nいつまでもごっこ遊びをしてるつもりなら、俺は抜ける。\n世界を書:
I won't be silent.
If you're going to keep playing house, I'm out.
I'm only helping because you said you'd rewrite the world.
m920240.（……王子を、知らない？\nその辺りの野盗ならまだしも、\nあれだけの気迫をまと:
(……He doesn't know the Prince?
I can understand if he were some backwater bandit,
but a top-tier warrior with that kind of presence?)
m920240.（あれは、似て非なるものよ。\n私たちがかつて用いた神の楔とは、本質が違うの）:
(That is something entirely different.
It is fundamentally different from the Divine Wedges we once used.)
m920240.（この力は……なぜ、\n『神の楔』が、意思を持っているのですか……？）:
(This power… why does
the 『Divine Wedge』 have a will of its own…?)
m920240.（これが、この方が、英雄王……。\nいえ、英雄王の、肉体……）:
(So this is him. The Hero King……
No, the Hero King's…… body……)
m920240.（ご主人様に、彼を殺させる……？\nそんなことが、果たして赦されるのか……）:
(Have my Master kill him……?
Is that something that can truly be forgiven……)
m920240.（不確定要素もあるけど……。\nエヴェリーナ公爵たちの企みが上手く進めば、\nむ:
(There are still some unknowns, though……
If Duke Everlina's plan goes well,
things should actually turn out for the best.)
m920240.（創造神が、世界を生み出した力の欠片）: (A fragment of the power with which the Creator God brought the world into being.)
m920240.（黒き導きから引き剥がされて、\nようやくその姿が、微かに見え始めた。\nあれは:
(Now that it has been torn away from Black Guidance,
its true form is beginning to faintly reveal itself.
That is… the beginning of this world. The First Divine Wedge.)

m950003.――おや、じゃあこの戦いも\nレーヴの記録に残るってことかい？: —Oh, so this battle will also end up in Reve's records, huh?
m950003.――くっくっく、知ってるか？\n聖霊にはすげぇ価値があるんだぜ。: Heh heh heh, you know? The Holy Spirit's got serious value.
m950003.――王子さま、みんなを助けてくれてありがとう！\nうぅぅ、無事で本当によかったぁ: Prince, thank you for saving everyone! Ugh, I'm so relieved you're safe…
m950003.…………あぁっ！ その顔！\nもしかして王国の王子さま！？: ………Ah! That face! Could it be the Prince of the kingdom!?
m950003.……話を聞くには、落ち着かせるしかなさそうだねぇ。\n実力行使ってやつさ、王子。: …Seems the only way to hear them out is to calm them down, huh. That's what we call using force, Prince.
m950003.あっ、あなたの物語がぴったりかも！: Ah, your story might be perfect!
m950003.あなたたちも聖霊を捕まえる悪いやつ！？\nえーいっ！ やっつけちゃうんだからー！: You guys are the bad guys trying to catch the Holy Spirit?! Hah! We'll take you down!!
m950003.あれ……あのちっこいの、聖霊さんじゃないですか？\nなんだか慌てているみたいです: Hey… that tiny one, isn't it a Holy Spirit? It looks panicked…
m950003.いいのいいの♪\nこの本に物語を描かれたみんなの\n技量を、私が高めてあげるね♪: It's fine, fine♪ I'll boost the skills of everyone whose tale is written in this book♪
m950003.うぅぅぅ……アカシちゃん、\n無事に王子さまの所へたどり着けたでしょうか……。: Uuu… Akashi-chan, did we make it safely to the Prince's side…?
m950003.うっひょぉ！\nそれじゃあこいつらを捕まえれば、\nしばらくは食いっぱぐれねぇっ: Woohoo! So if we capture them, we won't go hungry for a while, huh?!
m950003.えぇ、未来の王国のためにも、\n王子の辿ってきた歴史を\n編纂する事業を本格的に: Yeah, we're thinking of officially kicking off a project to compile the history the Prince has walked for the future kingdom.
m950003.えぇと……それじゃあ、お願いします……？\nと、ともかく！ これで一段落ですね。: Um… then, please…? Anyway! That wraps it up. Prince, shall we head back to the Aegis Temple?♪
m950003.えっと、そうだ！\n悪い盗賊が仲間たちを捕まえようとしてるの！: Um, right! Those nasty thieves were trying to capture our friends!
m950003.えっ？ これは物語というか王国史で――: Huh? This is more like a kingdom's history than a story—
m950003.おうよ、こいつらは戦士の技量を高めたり、\n新たな力を芽生えさせる奇跡を起こせる: Yeah, these can boost a warrior's skill and even spark miracles that give rise to new powers.
m950003.おや、私たちも記録に残るのですか？: Oh? Are we going to be in the records too?
m950003.お礼に、私の力を王子さまの仲間にあげるね！: As a thank-you, I'll give my power to your companions!
m950003.お願い、王子さま！\n悪い盗賊たちから、仲間を助けてほしいの！: Please, Prince! Save my friends from those vile thieves!
m950003.きっと大丈夫ですよ！\n王子さまは、こういう時には必ず駆けつけて――: I'm sure it'll be fine! The Prince always rushes in at times like these—
m950003.こ、来ないで！\n少しでも触ったらぶっ飛ばすわよ！: D-Don't come near! If you even touch it a little, I'll blast you away!
m950003.それで、助けを呼ぼうと思って、\n王国の方まで急いで飛んでる最中で――: So I tried to call for help, and was rushing all the way to the kingdom—
m950003.ちっ、こうなったら仕方ねぇ！\n野郎ども、王子を捕まえて売っぱらうぞ！: Damn it, looks like we've got no choice! You bastards, we'll capture the Prince and sell him!
m950003.なっ……お、王国軍だとぉ！？\nどうしてこんな所にいやがるんだ！？: Wh—what? The kingdom's troops?! What are you doing here!?
m950003.はいはい、話は詰め所で聞くからな。\n生活に困ってるなら仕事も斡旋するから、\n: Yeah, yeah, we'll hear your story at the interrogation room. If you're struggling to make ends meet, we can find you work. First, pay for your crimes.
m950003.ふふふ、皆さんの記録もしっかり書き残しますよ。\nそのために、王子をはじめ、\n: Hehe, we'll make sure to record everyone's stories too. That's why, besides the Prince, we've asked everyone who was off-duty today to come along.
m950003.わ、悪かった！ 改心するから！\n頼むぅ、見逃してくれぇ！: I'm sorry! I'll change my ways! Please, spare me!
m950003.わぁぁ～っ！！\n来ないでー！ あっちいってー！: Waaah!! Stay away! Go over there!
m950003.わっ……た、助けてくれたってこと？\nごめんなさい！ 敵だと思って暴れちゃって…: Whew… you saved me? I'm sorry! I thought you were an enemy and went berserk…!
m950003.アイギス神殿近くの森ですよ。\n聖霊さん、そろそろ落ち着きましたか？: We're in the forest near the Aegis Temple. Holy Spirit, have you calmed down yet?
m950003.大丈夫ですよ、どちらも怪我がなくて良かったです。\nそれで、いったい何があったの: It's alright, glad neither of you got hurt. So, what actually happened?
m950003.当たり前ですよ！\n皆さんのことも記録しなくちゃ、\n王国史とは言えませんからね: Of course! If we don't record you all, it can't be called the kingdom's history!
m950003.慌てすぎてこっちに突っ込んできますよ！？: It's so panicked it's charging right at us!?
m950003.懐かしい思い出もあれば、\n辛かったことも、悲しかったことも、\nそれ以上に嬉し: There are nostalgic memories, painful moments, sad times, and more than that, plenty of happy ones.
m950003.戦い……？ って、わ、わー！\n王子、大変です！ 魔物の群れが！: Battle…? Wh-what! Prince, it's terrible! A horde of monsters!
m950003.王国内で悪事を働くやつがいたら、\nそいつらを成敗するのも王国軍の役目だからな！: If anyone commits crimes in the kingdom, it's the army's job to bring them to justice! So just stay still and get tied up!
m950003.王子、どうしますか――と、\n尋ねるまでもなさそうですね。\nそれでは聖霊さん、: Prince, what will you do—well, I guess there's no need to ask. Then, Holy Spirit, please guide us!
m950003.王子、敵が来るぞ！\n聖霊を守りながらの戦闘だ、慎重な指揮を頼む！: Prince, enemies are coming! Fight while protecting the Holy Spirit—please command carefully!
m950003.王子と一緒に戦う中で、\nこれまで色々なことを経験しましたよね。: While fighting alongside the Prince, we've experienced all sorts of things, haven't we?
m950003.王子をって……そんなことさせませんよ！？: Capture the Prince… we won't let that happen!?
m950003.私は物語を通して、みんなに力を与えられるの。\nよーし、どこかに手頃な物語はっと: Through stories I can grant everyone strength. Alright, let's find a fitting tale somewhere…
m950003.聖霊さんの、力ですか？: The Holy Spirit's power, you mean?
m950003.護衛に付いてきて正解だったみたいだな。\n王子、皆に迎撃の指揮を頼むぞ！: Looks like tagging along as a guard was the right call. Prince, I need you to command everyone in the interception!
